### Reconstructing Ranking from national grade histories

The reconstruction uses the national performance records, including students
without admission records. Official annual guides and conversion tables are
archived in `f08/sources/ranking/`. The reconstruction is a proxy, and its agreement
with observed Ranking is assessed separately by admission process, school history,
and PACE-school status. Observed Ranking is never used to estimate the school
reference means or maxima. The new Ranking reform announced for admission 2028
is outside the sample.

```{r f08-ranking-histories}
library(data.table)
setDTthreads(4)
rk_input <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/input/f08'
rk_out <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking'
rk_sources <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/sources/ranking'
dir.create(rk_out, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
rk_cache <- file.path(rk_input, 'ranking_grade_records_2010_2023.rds')
if (!file.exists(rk_cache)) {
  x <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input, 'panel_performance_2002_2023.rds')))
  x <- x[AGNO>=2010 & COD_ENSE %in% c(310L,410L,510L,610L,710L,810L,910L) &
    COD_GRADO %in% 1:4, .(MRUN,AGNO,RBD,COD_ENSE,COD_GRADO,PROM_GRAL,SIT_FIN_R)]
  saveRDS(x, rk_cache)
  rm(x); gc()
}
rk_wide_file <- file.path(rk_input,'ranking_passed_histories.rds')
if (!file.exists(rk_wide_file)) {
  x <- rbindlist(list(readRDS(rk_cache),
    as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'rendimiento_grades_2024_2025.rds')))[
      COD_ENSE %in% c(310L,410L,510L,610L,710L,810L,910L) & COD_GRADO %in% 1:4]),
    use.names=TRUE)
  fwrite(x[,.(records=.N, passed=sum(SIT_FIN_R=='P',na.rm=TRUE),
    passed_invalid_grade=sum(SIT_FIN_R=='P' & (is.na(PROM_GRAL)|PROM_GRAL<1|PROM_GRAL>7),na.rm=TRUE)),by=AGNO],
    file.path(rk_out,'grade_record_audit.csv'))
  x <- unique(x[SIT_FIN_R=='P' & MRUN>0 & RBD>0 & between(PROM_GRAL,1,7),
    .(MRUN,grade=COD_GRADO,year=AGNO,rbd=RBD,teaching=COD_ENSE,gpa=PROM_GRAL)])
  # Identical duplicates collapse; conflicting or multiple passed records remain unknown.
  x[, records:=.N, by=.(MRUN,grade)]
  fwrite(x[,.(records=.N,ambiguous_records=sum(records>1L)),by=.(year,grade)],
    file.path(rk_out,'passed_record_ambiguity.csv'))
  x <- x[records==1L]
  rk_wide <- dcast(x, MRUN~grade, value.var=c('year','rbd','teaching','gpa'))
  saveRDS(rk_wide,rk_wide_file)
  rm(x,rk_wide);gc()
}
rk_wide <- readRDS(rk_wide_file)
rk_grad <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'graduates_pace_audit.rds')))
rk_raw <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'student_pace_2020_2025.rds')))
rk_adm <- rk_raw[year>=2021,.(MRUN=mrun,grad_year=as.integer(year)-1L,
  registration_record=TRUE,reported_grad_year=egreso_yyyy,
  reported_gpa=promedio_notas,reported_nem=nem,reported_ranking=ranking,
  any_current_exam=lenguaje_actual>0 | matematica_actual>0 | historia_actual>0 | ciencias_actual>0,
  mandatory_current_exams=lenguaje_actual>0 & matematica_actual>0)]
rk_2026 <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'paes_2026.rds'))$a)
rk_adm <- rbindlist(list(rk_adm, rk_2026[,.(MRUN,grad_year=2025L,
  registration_record=TRUE,reported_grad_year=NA_real_,reported_gpa=PROMEDIO_NOTAS,
  reported_nem=PTJE_NEM,reported_ranking=PTJE_RANKING,
  any_current_exam=CLEC_REG_ACTUAL>0 | MATE1_REG_ACTUAL>0,
  mandatory_current_exams=CLEC_REG_ACTUAL>0 & MATE1_REG_ACTUAL>0)]),use.names=TRUE)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rk_adm,by=c('MRUN','grad_year')))
rk_adm[reported_ranking<=0,reported_ranking:=NA_real_]
rk_adm[,reported_gpa:=round(reported_gpa,2)]
rk_target <- merge(rk_grad[,.(MRUN,grad_year,RBD,pace12,school_both,minimum_ranking,top_share)],
                   rk_adm,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
rk_target <- merge(rk_target,rk_wide,by='MRUN',all.x=TRUE)
rk_target[, missing_reason:=fcase(!is.na(reported_ranking),'Ranking observed',
  is.na(registration_record),'No admission/registration record',
  mandatory_current_exams==TRUE,'Registered; both mandatory exams observed; Ranking missing',
  any_current_exam==TRUE,'Registered; some exam observed; Ranking missing',
  default='Registered; no positive observed current exam; Ranking missing')]
fwrite(rk_target[, .N, by=.(grad_year,missing_reason)],file.path(rk_out,'ranking_missingness.csv'))
rk_target[, complete_history:=!is.na(gpa_1+gpa_2+gpa_3+gpa_4) &
  year_1<year_2 & year_2<year_3 & year_3<year_4 & year_4==grad_year]
rk_target[is.na(complete_history),complete_history:=FALSE]
rk_target[, gpa_round:=floor((gpa_1+gpa_2+gpa_3+gpa_4)/4*100+0.5+1e-8)/100]
rk_target[, gpa_trunc:=floor((gpa_1+gpa_2+gpa_3+gpa_4)/4*100+1e-8)/100]
rk_target[, nem_group:=fifelse(teaching_4==310L,'A','C')]
rk_target[, one_school:=rbd_1==rbd_2 & rbd_2==rbd_3 & rbd_3==rbd_4]
saveRDS(rk_target,file.path(rk_input,'ranking_targets.rds'))
fwrite(rk_target[,.(graduates=.N,observed=sum(!is.na(reported_ranking)),
  complete_history=sum(complete_history),
  missing_rank_complete_history=sum(is.na(reported_ranking)&complete_history)),by=grad_year],
  file.path(rk_out,'ranking_history_coverage.csv'))
knitr::kable(fread(file.path(rk_out,'ranking_missingness.csv')))
```

```{r f08-ranking-contexts}
# Ten possible contiguous grade intervals. Historical populations are defined
# by the school at the end of each interval; prior grades follow each student.
# A same-school-only reference is retained as a sensitivity to this operational detail.
trunc2 <- function(x) floor(x*100+1e-8)/100
rk_ref_file <- file.path(rk_input,'ranking_reference_summaries.rds')
if (!file.exists(rk_ref_file)) {
  ref <- list(); ct <- 0L
  for (first in 1:4) for (last in first:4) {
    gg<-paste0('gpa_',first:last); yy<-paste0('year_',first:last)
    rr<-paste0('rbd_',first:last)
    z<-rk_wide[!is.na(get(paste0('year_',last))) &
      get(paste0('year_',last))>=2013 & get(paste0('year_',last))<=2024]
    z[,g:=trunc2(rowMeans(.SD)),.SDcols=gg]
    z[,chronological:=TRUE]
    if(first<last) for(j in first:(last-1L))
      z[,chronological:=chronological & get(paste0('year_',j))<get(paste0('year_',j+1L))]
    z<-z[!is.na(g) & chronological==TRUE]
    z[,same:=rowSums(.SD==get(paste0('rbd_',last)))==length(rr),.SDcols=rr]
    for (method in c('exit_school','same_school')) {
      zz<-if(method=='same_school')z[same==TRUE] else z
      ans<-zz[,.(n=.N,grade_sum=sum(g),grade_max=max(g)),
        by=.(rbd=get(paste0('rbd_',last)),exit_year=get(paste0('year_',last)))]
      ans[,`:=`(first=first,last=last,reference=method)]
      ct<-ct+1L;ref[[ct]]<-ans
    }
  }
  rk_ref<-rbindlist(ref);saveRDS(rk_ref,rk_ref_file)
  rm(ref,z,zz,ans);gc()
}
rk_ref<-readRDS(rk_ref_file)
rk_contexts<-list();ct<-0L
for(first in 1:4)for(last in first:4){
  z<-rk_target[complete_history==TRUE]
  same<-rep(TRUE,nrow(z))
  for(j in first:last) same<-same & z[[paste0('rbd_',j)]]==z[[paste0('rbd_',first)]]
  if(first>1L)same<-same & z[[paste0('rbd_',first-1L)]]!=z[[paste0('rbd_',first)]]
  if(last<4L)same<-same & z[[paste0('rbd_',last+1L)]]!=z[[paste0('rbd_',last)]]
  z<-z[same]
  z[,context_grade:=trunc2(rowMeans(.SD)),.SDcols=paste0('gpa_',first:last)]
  z[,context_grade_round:=floor(rowMeans(.SD)*100+0.5+1e-8)/100,
    .SDcols=paste0('gpa_',first:last)]
  ct<-ct+1L
  rk_contexts[[ct]]<-z[,.(MRUN,grad_year,first=first,last=last,length=last-first+1L,
    rbd=get(paste0('rbd_',last)),exit_year=get(paste0('year_',last)),
    context_grade,context_grade_round,nem_group,
    context_group=fifelse(get(paste0('teaching_',last))==310L,'A','C'))]
}
rk_contexts<-rbindlist(rk_contexts)
stopifnot(rk_contexts[,all(sum(length)==4L),by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]$V1)
# Use the actual year of passing the context's final grade. The scheduled-year
# variant is retained separately for the earlier fixed-admission-reference wording.
keys<-unique(rk_contexts[,.(rbd,exit_year,first,last)])
lagged<-rbindlist(lapply(1:3,function(lag){q<-copy(rk_ref);q[,exit_year:=exit_year+lag];q}))
rk_summary<-lagged[keys,on=.(rbd,exit_year,first,last),allow.cartesian=TRUE,nomatch=0][,
  .(reference_n=sum(n),reference_generations=.N,historical_mean=trunc2(sum(grade_sum)/sum(n)),
    historical_mean_equal_cohort=trunc2(mean(grade_sum/n)),
    historical_max=trunc2(mean(grade_max))),by=.(rbd,exit_year,first,last,reference)]
rk_contexts<-rbindlist(lapply(c('exit_school','same_school'),function(method){
  z<-copy(rk_contexts);z[,reference:=method];z
}))
rk_contexts<-merge(rk_contexts,rk_summary,
  by=c('rbd','exit_year','first','last','reference'),all.x=TRUE)
stopifnot(rk_contexts[,sum(length),by=.(MRUN,grad_year,reference)]$V1==4L)
# Small contexts require an official grouping with comparable schools. Do not
# present a locally invented group as an official reconstruction.
rk_contexts[,reference_usable:=reference_n>=30L & historical_max>historical_mean]
saveRDS(rk_contexts,file.path(rk_input,'ranking_contexts.rds'))
fwrite(rk_contexts[,.(contexts=.N,small_or_unknown=sum(is.na(reference_usable)|!reference_usable),
  missing_generation=sum(reference_generations<3,na.rm=TRUE)),by=.(grad_year,reference)],
  file.path(rk_out,'ranking_reference_coverage.csv'))
```

```{r f08-ranking-nem-tables}
# Official current tables and archived historical tables; the Group C historical
# reproduction is checked against the ministry's own published 0.1-grade anchors.
current<-rbindlist(lapply(c('A','C'),function(group){
  doc<-xml2::read_html(file.path(rk_sources,paste0('nem_current_',tolower(group),'.html')))
  rows<-xml2::xml_find_all(doc,"//table//tr[td]")
  vals<-lapply(rows,function(r)as.numeric(gsub(',','.',xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_all(r,'./td')),fixed=TRUE)))
  ans<-as.data.table(do.call(rbind,vals));setnames(ans,c('gpa','score'))
  ans[,nem_group:=group];ans
}))
stopifnot(current[,all(.N==301L),by=nem_group]$V1,
          !anyDuplicated(current,by=c('nem_group','gpa')))
fwrite(current,file.path(rk_out,'official_current_nem_tables.csv'))
parse_grade_rows<-function(lines,k){
  pat<-paste0('^[4-7](,[0-9]{1,2})?',paste(rep(' [0-9]+',k-1L),collapse=''),'$')
  mat<-do.call(rbind,strsplit(grep(pat,trimws(lines),value=TRUE),' +'))
  as.data.table(matrix(as.numeric(gsub(',','.',mat,fixed=TRUE)),ncol=k))
}
old_a<-unique(parse_grade_rows(readLines(file.path(rk_sources,'demre_nem_a_2019_archive.txt'),warn=FALSE),7L))
setnames(old_a,c('gpa',as.character(2018:2023)))
lc<-readLines(file.path(rk_sources,'mineduc_access_tables_2020.txt'),warn=FALSE)
old_c<-unique(parse_grade_rows(lc[(which(lc=='--- PAGE 18 ---')+1L):length(lc)],5L))
setnames(old_c,c('gpa',as.character(2020:2023)))
book<-readLines(file.path(rk_sources,'mineduc_2019_nem_tables.txt'),warn=FALSE)
bk_start<-grep('^Tabla 4. Proyección de conversión',book)[1]
bk_end<-grep('^b\\) Batería de pruebas',book)[1]-1L
anchors_c<-unique(parse_grade_rows(book[bk_start:bk_end],7L))
setnames(anchors_c,c('gpa',as.character(2018:2023)))
stopifnot(nrow(old_a)==301L,nrow(old_c)==301L,nrow(anchors_c)==31L,
  !anyDuplicated(old_a$gpa),!anyDuplicated(old_c$gpa))
cross_c<-merge(old_c,anchors_c,by='gpa',suffixes=c('_copy','_ministry'))
stopifnot(all(vapply(2020:2023,function(y)
  all(cross_c[[paste0(y,'_copy')]]==cross_c[[paste0(y,'_ministry')]]),logical(1))))
old_tables<-rbindlist(lapply(2020:2021,function(y)rbindlist(list(
  old_a[,.(grad_year=y,nem_group='A',gpa,score=get(as.character(y+1L)),
    source='DEMRE archived table, printed March 2019')],
  old_c[,.(grad_year=y,nem_group='C',gpa,score=get(as.character(y+1L)),
    source='historical DEMRE table reproduced by school; all 31 ministry anchors verified')]))))
fwrite(old_tables,file.path(rk_out,'historical_nem_tables.csv'))
# Modal observed GPA/NEM cells provide a separate external-data validation;
# none of these student records determines the tables used in reconstruction.
# The harmonized 2023--2025 average-grade field has only integer precision; use the
# reconstructed rounded four-grade mean for those years, retaining that caveat.
lookup<-rk_target[reported_nem>0 & complete_history & !is.na(nem_group),
  .N,by=.(grad_year,nem_group,gpa=ifelse(grad_year %in% 2022:2024,gpa_round,reported_gpa),score=reported_nem)]
lookup<-lookup[gpa>=4 & gpa<=7]
lookup[,total:=sum(N),by=.(grad_year,nem_group,gpa)]
setorder(lookup,grad_year,nem_group,gpa,-N,score)
lookup<-lookup[, .SD[1L],by=.(grad_year,nem_group,gpa)]
lookup[,dominance:=N/total]
fwrite(lookup,file.path(rk_out,'observed_gpa_nem_lookup.csv'))
check<-merge(lookup,current,by=c('nem_group','gpa'),suffixes=c('_observed','_current'))
fwrite(check[,.(gpa_cells=.N,students=sum(total),agreement=sum(N*(score_observed==score_current))/sum(N),
  max_abs_difference=max(abs(score_observed-score_current))),by=.(grad_year,nem_group)],
  file.path(rk_out,'nem_table_year_validation.csv'))

  q<-copy(current);q[,`:=`(grad_year=y,source='official current table; annual agreement checked')];q

old_check<-merge(lookup[grad_year<=2021],old_tables,
```

```{r f08-ranking-score-validation}
rk_contexts<-readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'ranking_contexts.rds'))
nem_lookup<-function(gpa,year,group){
  q<-data.table(id=seq_along(gpa),grad_year=year,nem_group=group,
    grade100=as.integer(floor(gpa*100+0.5+1e-8)))
  tab<-copy(rk_tables);tab[,grade100:=as.integer(round(gpa*100))]
  ans<-tab[q,on=.(grad_year,nem_group,grade100)]
  ans[order(id),score]
}
# Baseline uses the completed schooling modality's conversion table. A
# context-specific-modality variant is saved as an explicit sensitivity.
score_context<-function(z,group){
  base<-nem_lookup(z$context_grade,z$grad_year,group)
  h<-nem_lookup(z$historical_mean,z$grad_year,group)
  cap<-ifelse(z$grad_year<=2021,850,1000)
  s<-ifelse(z$context_grade<=z$historical_mean,base,
    ifelse(z$context_grade>=z$historical_max,cap,
      h+(cap-h)*(z$context_grade-z$historical_mean)/(z$historical_max-z$historical_mean)))
  s[is.na(z$reference_usable)|!z$reference_usable]<-NA_real_
  s
}
rk_contexts[,score:=score_context(.SD,nem_group)]
rk_contexts[,score_context_modality:=score_context(.SD,context_group)]
rk_rounded<-copy(rk_contexts)
rk_rounded[,context_grade:=context_grade_round]
rk_contexts[,score_rounded:=score_context(rk_rounded,nem_group)]
rk_rounded[,historical_mean:=historical_mean_equal_cohort]
rk_contexts[,score_equal_cohort_rounded:=score_context(rk_rounded,nem_group)]
rk_rounded[,context_grade:=rk_contexts$context_grade]
rk_contexts[,score_equal_cohort:=score_context(rk_rounded,nem_group)]
rm(rk_rounded)
rk_proxy<-rk_contexts[,.(proxy_unrounded=sum(score*length)/4,
  proxy_rounded_unrounded=sum(score_rounded*length)/4,
  proxy_equal_cohort_unrounded=sum(score_equal_cohort*length)/4,
  proxy_equal_cohort_rounded_unrounded=sum(score_equal_cohort_rounded*length)/4,
  proxy_modality_unrounded=sum(score_context_modality*length)/4,
  n_contexts=.N,minimum_reference_n=min(reference_n),
  all_references_usable=all(reference_usable)),by=.(MRUN,grad_year,reference)]
rk_proxy<-merge(rk_proxy,rk_target,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
rk_proxy[,nem_reconstructed:=nem_lookup(gpa_round,grad_year,nem_group)]
rk_proxy[,ranking_proxy:=pmax(floor(proxy_unrounded+0.5+1e-8),nem_reconstructed)]
rk_proxy[,ranking_proxy_context_modality:=pmax(floor(proxy_modality_unrounded+0.5+1e-8),nem_reconstructed)]
rk_proxy[,ranking_proxy_rounded:=pmax(floor(proxy_rounded_unrounded+0.5+1e-8),nem_reconstructed)]
rk_proxy[,ranking_proxy_equal_cohort:=pmax(floor(proxy_equal_cohort_unrounded+0.5+1e-8),nem_reconstructed)]
rk_proxy[,ranking_proxy_equal_cohort_rounded:=pmax(floor(proxy_equal_cohort_rounded_unrounded+0.5+1e-8),nem_reconstructed)]
rk_proxy[,error:=ranking_proxy-reported_ranking]
rk_proxy[,nem_error:=nem_reconstructed-reported_nem]
saveRDS(rk_proxy,file.path(rk_input,'ranking_proxy_validation.rds'))
metric<-function(e){e<-e[is.finite(e)];list(n=length(e),bias=mean(e),mae=mean(abs(e)),
  rmse=sqrt(mean(e^2)),exact=mean(e==0),within_1=mean(abs(e)<=1),within_5=mean(abs(e)<=5),
  within_10=mean(abs(e)<=10),p95_abs=as.numeric(quantile(abs(e),.95)))}
fwrite(rk_proxy[!is.na(error),metric(error),by=.(grad_year,reference)],
  file.path(rk_out,'ranking_validation_by_year.csv'))
fwrite(rk_proxy[!is.na(error),metric(error),by=.(grad_year,reference,one_school)],
  file.path(rk_out,'ranking_validation_by_school_history.csv'))
fwrite(rk_proxy[!is.na(error),metric(error),by=.(grad_year,reference,pace12)],
  file.path(rk_out,'ranking_validation_by_pace.csv'))
fwrite(rk_proxy[!is.na(error),metric(ranking_proxy_context_modality-reported_ranking),
  by=.(grad_year,reference)],file.path(rk_out,'ranking_modality_sensitivity.csv'))
fwrite(rk_proxy[!is.na(error),metric(ranking_proxy_rounded-reported_ranking),
  by=.(grad_year,reference)],file.path(rk_out,'ranking_rounding_sensitivity.csv'))
fwrite(rbindlist(lapply(c('ranking_proxy','ranking_proxy_rounded',
  'ranking_proxy_equal_cohort','ranking_proxy_equal_cohort_rounded'),function(v){
    q<-rk_proxy[!is.na(error),metric(get(v)-reported_ranking),by=.(grad_year,reference)]
    q[,variant:=v];q})),file.path(rk_out,'ranking_implementation_sensitivities.csv'))
fwrite(rk_proxy[reference=='exit_school' & reported_nem>0,metric(nem_error),by=grad_year],
  file.path(rk_out,'nem_reconstruction_validation.csv'))
fwrite(rk_proxy[!is.na(error),.(n=.N,
  agreement=mean((ranking_proxy>=minimum_ranking)==(reported_ranking>=minimum_ranking)),
  false_positive=mean(ranking_proxy>=minimum_ranking & reported_ranking<minimum_ranking),
  false_negative=mean(ranking_proxy<minimum_ranking & reported_ranking>=minimum_ranking)),
  by=.(grad_year,reference)],file.path(rk_out,'absolute_threshold_validation.csv'))
knitr::kable(fread(file.path(rk_out,'ranking_validation_by_year.csv')))
```

```{r f08-ranking-discrepancy-summary}
# Aggregate diagnostics for recorded-versus-reconstructed differences. All
# comparisons use the same baseline validation sample; no identifiers exported.
rk_differences <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'ranking_proxy_validation.rds')))[
  reference=='exit_school' & is.finite(error)]
rk_differences[,nem_matches:=nem_error==0]
rk_differences[,error_band:=cut(abs(error),c(-Inf,0,1,5,10,25,50,Inf),
  labels=c('Exact','1 point','2-5 points','6-10 points','11-25 points',
           '26-50 points','Over 50 points'))]
error_bands <- rk_differences[,.N,by=error_band][order(error_band)]
error_bands[,share:=N/sum(N)]
stopifnot(sum(error_bands$N)==nrow(rk_differences))
fwrite(error_bands,file.path(rk_out,'ranking_discrepancy_bands.csv'))
discrepancy_metrics <- function(d) d[,.(n=.N,bias=mean(error),
  mae=mean(abs(error)),exact=mean(error==0),within_5=mean(abs(error)<=5),
  over_10=mean(abs(error)>10),over_50=mean(abs(error)>50),
  underestimated=mean(error<0),overestimated=mean(error>0))]
discrepancy_groups <- rbindlist(list(
  cbind(group='All validated graduates',discrepancy_metrics(rk_differences)),
  rk_differences[,cbind(group=paste0('PACE school: ',pace12),
    discrepancy_metrics(.SD)),by=pace12][,pace12:=NULL],
  rk_differences[,cbind(group=paste0('One school: ',one_school),
    discrepancy_metrics(.SD)),by=one_school][,one_school:=NULL],
  rk_differences[,cbind(group=paste0('NEM exactly matches: ',nem_matches),
    discrepancy_metrics(.SD)),by=nem_matches][,nem_matches:=NULL],
  rk_differences[,cbind(group=paste0('Admission: ',grad_year+1L),
    discrepancy_metrics(.SD)),by=grad_year][,grad_year:=NULL]
),use.names=TRUE)
fwrite(discrepancy_groups,file.path(rk_out,'ranking_discrepancy_groups.csv'))
cutoff_groups <- rk_differences[,.(n=.N,
  disagreement=mean((ranking_proxy>=minimum_ranking)!=(reported_ranking>=minimum_ranking)),
  false_positive=mean(ranking_proxy>=minimum_ranking & reported_ranking<minimum_ranking),
  false_negative=mean(ranking_proxy<minimum_ranking & reported_ranking>=minimum_ranking)),
  by=.(pace12,near_cutoff=abs(reported_ranking-minimum_ranking)<=10)]
fwrite(cutoff_groups,file.path(rk_out,'ranking_discrepancy_cutoff_groups.csv'))
fwrite(rk_differences[abs(error)>10,.(n=.N,
  pace_share=mean(pace12==1,na.rm=TRUE),nem_matches=mean(nem_matches,na.rm=TRUE),
  underestimated=mean(error<0))],file.path(rk_out,'ranking_large_discrepancy_summary.csv'))
knitr::kable(error_bands)
knitr::kable(discrepancy_groups)
```

```{r f08-ranking-small-differences}
# Diagnostic requested after the main validation: strictly nonzero differences
# below five points (1--4), with exactly five points kept separately.
# These audits do not change the production reconstruction or select its rules.
library(data.table)
rk_input <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/input/f08'
rk_out <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking'
sd_score <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'ranking_proxy_validation.rds')))[
  reference=='exit_school' & is.finite(error)]
sd_target <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'ranking_targets.rds')))
sd_context <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'ranking_contexts.rds')))[reference=='exit_school']
sd_ref <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'ranking_reference_summaries.rds')))[reference=='exit_school']
sd_score[,difference_group:=factor(fcase(error==0,'Exact',abs(error)<5,'1-4 points',
  abs(error)==5,'5 points',default='Over 5 points'),
  levels=c('Exact','1-4 points','5 points','Over 5 points'))]
sd_size <- sd_target[!is.na(RBD),.(graduating_cohort_n=.N),by=.(grad_year,RBD)]
sd_score <- merge(sd_score,sd_size,by=c('grad_year','RBD'),all.x=TRUE)
sd_score[,`:=`(nem_matches=nem_error==0,ranking_bonus=reported_ranking>reported_nem,
  size_band=cut(graduating_cohort_n,c(0,49,99,199,Inf),
    labels=c('1-49','50-99','100-199','200+')))]
sd_group <- sd_score[,.(n=.N,median_graduating_cohort=as.numeric(median(graduating_cohort_n,na.rm=TRUE)),
  mean_graduating_cohort=mean(graduating_cohort_n,na.rm=TRUE),
  share_cohort_under_50=mean(graduating_cohort_n<50,na.rm=TRUE),
  median_minimum_reference_n=as.numeric(median(minimum_reference_n)),
  share_reference_under_100=mean(minimum_reference_n<100),
  complete_own_history=mean(complete_history),nem_exact=mean(nem_matches),
  nem_mismatch_n=sum(!nem_matches),nem_mae=mean(abs(nem_error)),
  one_school=mean(one_school),ranking_bonus=mean(ranking_bonus)),by=difference_group]
setorder(sd_group,difference_group)
fwrite(sd_group,file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_group_summary.csv'))
sd_gradients <- rbindlist(lapply(c('All validated','Positive recorded Ranking bonus'),function(s){
  d<-if(s=='All validated')sd_score else sd_score[ranking_bonus==TRUE]
  d[,.(sample=s,n=.N,small_difference=mean(abs(error)>0 & abs(error)<5),
    exact=mean(error==0),over_5=mean(abs(error)>5)),by=.(size_band)]
}))
fwrite(sd_gradients,file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_school_size_gradient.csv'))
fwrite(sd_score[,.(n=.N,small_difference=mean(abs(error)>0 & abs(error)<5),
  exact=mean(error==0)),by=.(grad_year,pace12,size_band,ranking_bonus)],
  file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_school_size_by_cohort_pace_bonus.csv'))

# Separate the conversion-table stage from recovery of the student's GPA.
sd_tables <- fread(file.path(rk_out,'nem_tables_used.csv'))
sd_tables[,grade100:=as.integer(round(gpa*100))]
sd_lookup <- function(gpa,year,group){
  q<-data.table(id=seq_along(gpa),grad_year=year,nem_group=group,
    grade100=as.integer(floor(gpa*100+.5+1e-8)))
  sd_tables[q,on=.(grad_year,nem_group,grade100)][order(id),score]
}
sd_target[,nem_from_four_grades:=sd_lookup(gpa_round,grad_year,nem_group)]
sd_target[,nem_from_reported_gpa:=sd_lookup(reported_gpa,grad_year,nem_group)]
# The harmonized GPA field has only integer precision in admissions 2023--25.
sd_target[,reliable_reported_gpa:=!grad_year %in% 2022:2024 &
  between(reported_gpa,4,7) & reported_nem>0]
fwrite(sd_target[complete_history & reported_nem>0,
  .(n=.N,proxy_available=sum(!is.na(nem_from_four_grades)),
    exact_n=sum(nem_from_four_grades==reported_nem,na.rm=TRUE),
    exact=mean(nem_from_four_grades==reported_nem,na.rm=TRUE),
    mae=mean(abs(nem_from_four_grades-reported_nem),na.rm=TRUE)),by=grad_year],
  file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_nem_all_complete_histories.csv'))
sd_nem <- merge(sd_score[,.(MRUN,grad_year,difference_group)],sd_target[,
  .(MRUN,grad_year,reported_gpa,gpa_round,reported_nem,nem_from_four_grades,
    nem_from_reported_gpa,reliable_reported_gpa,nem_group)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'))
fwrite(sd_nem[reliable_reported_gpa==TRUE,.(n=.N,
  four_grade_gpa_exact=mean(abs(gpa_round-reported_gpa)<1e-7),
  reported_gpa_table_exact=mean(nem_from_reported_gpa==reported_nem),
  four_grade_nem_exact=mean(nem_from_four_grades==reported_nem)),
  by=.(grad_year,difference_group)],file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_nem_stage_validation.csv'))
fwrite(sd_tables[,.(gpa_rows=.N,distinct_scores=uniqueN(score),
  minimum_step=min(diff(score[order(gpa)]))),by=.(grad_year,nem_group)],
  file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_nem_table_invertibility.csv'))
fwrite(sd_nem[difference_group=='1-4 points',.(n=.N,nem_exact=sum(nem_from_four_grades==reported_nem),
  nem_mismatch=sum(nem_from_four_grades!=reported_nem)),by=.(grad_year,nem_group)],
  file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_nem_by_cohort_modality.csv'))

# Audit availability of each historical school/grade/year directly against the
# raw grade files, before exclusions for missing, ambiguous, or unordered histories.
# This is an internal completeness audit, not a match to an official DEMRE roster.
sd_raw_cache <- file.path(rk_input,'ranking_reference_raw_cohort_counts.rds')
if(!file.exists(sd_raw_cache)){
  sd_raw_counts <- rbindlist(lapply(c('ranking_grade_records_2010_2023.rds',
    'rendimiento_grades_2024_2025.rds'),function(f){
    d<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,f)))
    d<-unique(d[SIT_FIN_R=='P' & MRUN>0 & RBD>0 & COD_GRADO %in% 1:4 &
      COD_ENSE %in% c(310L,410L,510L,610L,710L,810L,910L),
      .(MRUN,rbd=RBD,ref_year=AGNO,last=COD_GRADO)])
    d[,.(raw_passed_n=.N),by=.(rbd,ref_year,last)]
  }))
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sd_raw_counts,by=c('rbd','ref_year','last')))
  saveRDS(sd_raw_counts,sd_raw_cache)
}
sd_raw_counts <- readRDS(sd_raw_cache)
sd_keys <- unique(sd_context[,.(rbd,exit_year,first,last)])
sd_required <- sd_keys[,.(lag=1:3),by=.(rbd,exit_year,first,last)]
sd_required[,ref_year:=exit_year-lag]
sd_required <- merge(sd_required,sd_raw_counts,by=c('rbd','ref_year','last'),all.x=TRUE)
sd_required <- merge(sd_required,sd_ref[,.(rbd,ref_year=exit_year,first,last,used_n=n)],
  by=c('rbd','ref_year','first','last'),all.x=TRUE)
sd_required[is.na(used_n),used_n:=0L]
stopifnot(sd_required[!is.na(raw_passed_n),all(used_n<=raw_passed_n)])
sd_available_years <- unique(sd_raw_counts$ref_year)
sd_coverage <- sd_required[,.(raw_reference_n=sum(raw_passed_n,na.rm=TRUE),
  used_reference_n=sum(used_n),raw_generations=sum(!is.na(raw_passed_n)),
  used_generations=sum(used_n>0),
  reference_year_in_file=all(ref_year %in% sd_available_years)),
  by=.(rbd,exit_year,first,last)]
sd_coverage[,retained_share:=used_reference_n/raw_reference_n]
sd_context <- merge(sd_context,sd_coverage,by=c('rbd','exit_year','first','last'),all.x=TRUE)
stopifnot(sd_context[!is.na(reference_n),all(reference_n==used_reference_n)])
sd_student_coverage <- sd_context[,.(all_three_raw_generations=all(raw_generations==3L),
  all_three_used_generations=all(used_generations==3L),
  all_required_year_files=all(reference_year_in_file),
  all_raw_reference_students_retained=all(used_reference_n==raw_reference_n),
  minimum_retained_share=min(retained_share),
  pooled_retained_share=sum(used_reference_n)/sum(raw_reference_n)),by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]
sd_score <- merge(sd_score,sd_student_coverage,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
sd_history_summary <- sd_score[,.(n=.N,
  all_required_year_files=mean(all_required_year_files),
  all_three_raw_generations=mean(all_three_raw_generations),
  all_three_used_generations=mean(all_three_used_generations),
  all_reference_students_retained=mean(all_raw_reference_students_retained),
  median_minimum_retained=median(minimum_retained_share),
  mean_minimum_retained=mean(minimum_retained_share),
  mean_pooled_retained=mean(pooled_retained_share)),by=difference_group]
setorder(sd_history_summary,difference_group)
fwrite(sd_history_summary,file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_historical_coverage.csv'))
fwrite(sd_score[,.(n=.N,nem_exact=mean(nem_matches)),by=.(difference_group,
  all_three_used_generations,all_raw_reference_students_retained)],
  file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_nem_by_historical_coverage.csv'))
fwrite(sd_required[,.(contexts=.N,school_grade_year_observed=sum(!is.na(raw_passed_n)),
  used_cohort_observed=sum(used_n>0)),by=ref_year],
  file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_required_historical_years.csv'))

# Existing alternative implementations help distinguish own-average precision
# and benchmark weighting from missing data. They remain sensitivity diagnostics.
sd_variants <- rbindlist(lapply(c('ranking_proxy','ranking_proxy_rounded',
  'ranking_proxy_equal_cohort','ranking_proxy_equal_cohort_rounded',
  'ranking_proxy_context_modality'),function(v){
  sd_score[abs(error)>0 & abs(error)<5,
    .(variant=v,n=.N,exact=mean(get(v)==reported_ranking),
      mae=mean(abs(get(v)-reported_ranking)),
      improved=mean(abs(get(v)-reported_ranking)<abs(error)),
      worsened=mean(abs(get(v)-reported_ranking)>abs(error))),by=nem_matches]
}))
fwrite(sd_variants,file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_existing_sensitivities.csv'))
# A stronger diagnostic holds fixed the student GPA/NEM, one-school context,
# availability of all three cohorts, and retention of every observed reference
# student. Remaining errors cannot be explained by those particular exclusions.
sd_score[,fully_observed_reference:=all_three_used_generations &
  all_raw_reference_students_retained]
sd_clean <- sd_score[nem_matches & one_school & fully_observed_reference]
sd_clean_summary <- sd_clean[,.(n=.N,exact=sum(error==0),
  small_differences=sum(abs(error)>0 & abs(error)<5),
  small_difference_share=mean(abs(error)>0 & abs(error)<5),
  over_5=sum(abs(error)>5)),by=.(own_rounding_identical=abs(gpa_round-gpa_trunc)<1e-7)]
fwrite(sd_clean_summary,file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_complete_reference_check.csv'))
fwrite(sd_score[abs(error)>0 & abs(error)<=5,.(n=.N,nem_exact=mean(nem_matches),
  median_graduating_cohort=median(graduating_cohort_n,na.rm=TRUE),
  all_three_used_generations=mean(all_three_used_generations))],
  file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_inclusive_five_sensitivity.csv'))
# Earlier than 2013, some raw cohorts exist but were omitted by the original
# reference-cache start-year restriction. Count affected validated records;
# do not silently change the baseline during this diagnostic.
sd_context[,earliest_required_year:=exit_year-3L]
sd_early <- sd_context[,.(early_reference=any(earliest_required_year<2013L)),by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]
fwrite(merge(sd_score[,.(MRUN,grad_year,difference_group)],sd_early,
  by=c('MRUN','grad_year'))[,.(n=.N,early_reference=sum(early_reference)),by=difference_group],
  file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_early_reference_audit.csv'))

sd_small <- sd_group[difference_group=='1-4 points']
sd_exact <- sd_group[difference_group=='Exact']
sd_hist <- sd_history_summary[difference_group=='1-4 points']
sd_stage <- sd_nem[reliable_reported_gpa & difference_group=='1-4 points',
  .(n=.N,table_exact=sum(nem_from_reported_gpa==reported_nem))]
sd_full <- sd_score[difference_group=='1-4 points' & fully_observed_reference,
  .(n=.N,nem_exact=sum(nem_matches))]
sd_early_small <- merge(sd_score[difference_group=='1-4 points',.(MRUN,grad_year)],
  sd_early,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'))[,sum(early_reference)]
sd_report <- c('# Audit of Ranking differences below five points',
  '', 'Scope: nonzero absolute differences of 1–4 points, admission processes 2021–2026. Exactly five points is separate; an inclusive 1–5 sensitivity is also exported. All statistics are generated by the `f08-ranking-small-differences` chunk in `analysis_for_adversarial_report.Rmd`. Production Ranking scores and manuscript tables are unchanged.',

  '', sprintf('There are %s records with differences of 1–4 points. Median graduating-cohort size is %.0f, compared with %.0f for exact matches; %.2f%% versus %.2f%% attend cohorts smaller than 50. The median smallest historical context contains %.0f versus %.0f reference students. These are student-weighted measures of graduating-cohort size, not total school enrollment.',
    format(sd_small$n,big.mark=',',trim=TRUE),sd_small$median_graduating_cohort,
    sd_exact$median_graduating_cohort,100*sd_small$share_cohort_under_50,
    100*sd_exact$share_cohort_under_50,sd_small$median_minimum_reference_n,
    sd_exact$median_minimum_reference_n),
  '', 'Exact Ranking matches often occur where Ranking equals NEM. The school-size gradient is therefore also exported conditional on a positive recorded Ranking bonus and separately by year, PACE-school status, and bonus status. This is a descriptive diagnostic, not a causal school-size comparison. Contexts below 30 historical students were not assigned a proxy and are outside the validation comparison.',
  '', '## NEM and the student GPA',
  '', sprintf('Reconstructing the four passed annual grades, rounding their mean to two decimals, and applying the year/modality-specific NEM table exactly reproduces NEM for %s of %s small-difference records (%.4f%%). The remaining %s cases do not replicate exactly. In the broader complete-history sample, annual NEM agreement is approximately 98.7–99.3%%.',
    format(sd_small$n-sd_small$nem_mismatch_n,big.mark=',',trim=TRUE),
    format(sd_small$n,big.mark=',',trim=TRUE),100*sd_small$nem_exact,
    format(sd_small$nem_mismatch_n,big.mark=',',trim=TRUE)),
  '', sprintf('For admissions 2021, 2022, and 2026, where the stored GPA has usable decimal precision, the official table applied directly to that GPA matches recorded NEM for all %s small-difference records checked. The stored GPA field for admissions 2023–2025 has lost decimal precision, so that direct stage cannot be checked in those extracts. All tables used here are strictly increasing across the 301 two-decimal GPA entries; exact NEM therefore identifies the corresponding rounded GPA, conditional on the correct year and modality.',
    format(sd_stage$n,big.mark=',',trim=TRUE)),
  '', 'NEM rounds the four-year average, whereas the published Ranking guide truncates context averages. Exact NEM alone does not validate that distinct rounding step, the split into school contexts, or final Ranking rounding. The existing own-average-rounding sensitivity resolves some differences but is not adopted as a rule correction.',

Nevertheless, only %.3f%% retain every observed raw reference student in every context. The mean within-student pooled retention rate is %.3f%% and the median minimum context retention rate is %.3f%%. Missing, ambiguous, invalid, or unordered grade histories can exclude individuals even when a cohort is present.',
    100*sd_hist$all_three_used_generations,100*sd_hist$all_reference_students_retained,
    100*sd_hist$mean_pooled_retained,100*sd_hist$median_minimum_retained),
  '', sprintf('There are still %s small-difference records with all three reference cohorts present and every raw reference student retained; %s of these also match NEM exactly. Thus exclusions for incomplete historical grade sequences cannot explain all discrepancies.',
    format(sd_full$n,big.mark=',',trim=TRUE),format(sd_full$nem_exact,big.mark=',',trim=TRUE)),
  '', sprintf('A stricter check leaves %s small-difference records with exact NEM, one school throughout, all three cohorts, every raw reference student retained, and identical rounded and truncated student GPA.     format(sd_clean_summary[own_rounding_identical==TRUE,small_differences],big.mark=',',trim=TRUE)),

This is a separate code-coverage limitation and does not explain the remaining cases.',

  '', 'Main outputs: `small_difference_group_summary.csv`, `small_difference_school_size_gradient.csv`, `small_difference_nem_stage_validation.csv`, `small_difference_historical_coverage.csv`, `small_difference_complete_reference_check.csv`, and `small_difference_existing_sensitivities.csv`. Aggregate outputs contain no student identifiers.')
stopifnot(sd_stage$n==sd_stage$table_exact)
writeLines(sd_report,file.path(rk_out,'small_difference_audit_2026-10-19.md'))
```

```{r f08-ranking-eligibility-validation}
# Published 2023 example: TP average 6.33, historical mean 6.00 and max 6.86.
example2023<-data.table(context_grade=6.33,grad_year=2022L,
  historical_mean=6.00,historical_max=6.86,reference_usable=TRUE)
stopifnot(floor(score_context(example2023,'C')+.5)==824L)
example2022<-copy(example2023);example2022[,grad_year:=2021L]
stopifnot(floor(score_context(example2022,'C')+.5)==713L)

rk_base<-rk_proxy[reference=='exit_school']
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rk_base,by=c('MRUN','grad_year')))
# Restore every graduate, including absent/incomplete grade histories.
rk_all<-merge(rk_target,rk_base[,.(MRUN,grad_year,ranking_proxy,ranking_proxy_rounded,
  ranking_proxy_equal_cohort,ranking_proxy_equal_cohort_rounded,
  nem_reconstructed,minimum_reference_n,n_contexts)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
rk_all[,proxy_reason:=fcase(!complete_history,'Incomplete/ambiguous passed-grade history',
  !is.na(ranking_proxy),'Proxy available',
  default='Unavailable/too small/degenerate reference or out-of-table grade')]
fwrite(rk_all[is.na(reported_ranking),.N,by=.(grad_year,proxy_reason)],
  file.path(rk_out,'ranking_missing_score_reconstruction.csv'))
fwrite(rk_all[,.(graduates=.N,observed=sum(!is.na(reported_ranking)),
  proxy=sum(!is.na(ranking_proxy)),imputed=sum(is.na(reported_ranking)&!is.na(ranking_proxy)),
  still_missing=sum(is.na(reported_ranking)&is.na(ranking_proxy))),by=grad_year],
  file.path(rk_out,'ranking_reconstruction_coverage.csv'))

# Classification checks near the cutoff must accompany high overall agreement.
rk_all[,near_absolute_cutoff:=abs(reported_ranking-minimum_ranking)<=10]
fwrite(rk_all[!is.na(ranking_proxy)&!is.na(reported_ranking),
  .(n=.N,agreement=mean((ranking_proxy>=minimum_ranking)==(reported_ranking>=minimum_ranking)),
    sensitivity=sum(ranking_proxy>=minimum_ranking & reported_ranking>=minimum_ranking)/sum(reported_ranking>=minimum_ranking),
    specificity=sum(ranking_proxy<minimum_ranking & reported_ranking<minimum_ranking)/sum(reported_ranking<minimum_ranking)),
  by=.(grad_year,near_absolute_cutoff,pace12)],file.path(rk_out,'absolute_threshold_detailed_validation.csv'))

# Known-score-only percentile validation uses an identical reference population
# for both scores. It tests relative ordering, not full official PACE eligibility.
pct_check<-rk_all[!is.na(reported_ranking)&!is.na(ranking_proxy)&!is.na(RBD)]
pct_check[,`:=`(obs_rank=frank(-reported_ranking,ties.method='min'),
  proxy_rank=frank(-ranking_proxy,ties.method='min'),class_n=.N),by=.(grad_year,RBD)]
pct_check[,`:=`(obs_or=reported_ranking>=minimum_ranking | obs_rank<=ceiling(top_share*class_n),
  proxy_or=ranking_proxy>=minimum_ranking | proxy_rank<=ceiling(top_share*class_n))]
fwrite(pct_check[,.(n=.N,agreement=mean(obs_or==proxy_or),
  false_positive=mean(proxy_or & !obs_or),false_negative=mean(!proxy_or & obs_or)),by=grad_year],
  file.path(rk_out,'academic_or_observed_reference_validation.csv'))

# Full-cohort diagnostic combines recorded Ranking with the proxy only where
# Ranking is missing. Known scores are never overwritten. Unresolved reference
# members and tied cutoffs produce partial classifications, rather than zeros.
rk_all[,ranking_augmented:=fcoalesce(as.numeric(reported_ranking),ranking_proxy)]
rk_all[,`:=`(cohort_n=.N,cohort_missing=sum(is.na(ranking_augmented)),
  best_rank=frank(-ranking_augmented,ties.method='min',na.last='keep'),
  worst_observed_rank=frank(-ranking_augmented,ties.method='max',na.last='keep')),
  by=.(grad_year,RBD)]
rk_all[,absolute_proxy:=ranking_augmented>=minimum_ranking]
rk_all[,academic_proxy_lower:=as.integer(!is.na(ranking_augmented) &
  (absolute_proxy | (!is.na(RBD) & worst_observed_rank+cohort_missing<=floor(top_share*cohort_n))))]
rk_all[,academic_proxy_upper:=as.integer(is.na(ranking_augmented) | absolute_proxy |
  is.na(RBD) | best_rank<=ceiling(top_share*cohort_n))]
rk_all[,academic_proxy_partial:=fifelse(academic_proxy_lower==academic_proxy_upper,
  academic_proxy_lower,NA_integer_)]
stopifnot(all(rk_all$academic_proxy_lower<=rk_all$academic_proxy_upper),
  all(rk_all[!is.na(reported_ranking),ranking_augmented==reported_ranking]))
fwrite(rk_all[,.(graduates=.N,missing_rank_after=sum(is.na(ranking_augmented)),
  academic_guaranteed=sum(academic_proxy_lower),academic_possible=sum(academic_proxy_upper),
  academic_unresolved=sum(is.na(academic_proxy_partial))),by=grad_year],
  file.path(rk_out,'academic_proxy_partial_coverage.csv'))
# These endpoints condition on proxy accuracy; they are not error-robust bounds.
saveRDS(rk_all,file.path(rk_input,'ranking_augmented_graduates.rds'))

# Validation within the original lottery sample, including differential errors.
lot<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(rk_input,'pace_finalized_panel.rds')))
valid<-merge(lot,rk_all[,.(MRUN,grad_year,reported_ranking,ranking_proxy)],
  by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
valid[,score_error:=ranking_proxy-reported_ranking]
fwrite(valid[!is.na(score_error),metric(score_error),by=.(YEAR,OFFER)],
  file.path(rk_out,'ranking_validation_by_lottery_offer.csv'))
valid<-merge(valid,fread('analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/pace_rules_2021_2026.csv')[,
  .(grad_year=new_graduation_cohort,cutoff=minimum_ranking)],by='grad_year',all.x=TRUE)
valid[,threshold_error:=as.integer(ranking_proxy>=cutoff)-as.integer(reported_ranking>=cutoff)]
ctrl<-c('GPA8_Z','ES_MUJER','PRIORITARIO','ALTO','ORIGIN_OD')
error_models<-rbindlist(lapply(c('score_error','threshold_error'),function(v){
  m<-fixest::feols(as.formula(paste(v,'~ OFFER + i(YEAR, ref=2016) +',
    paste(ctrl,collapse=' + '),'| CHANCE_GROUP')),data=valid[!is.na(score_error)],
    vcov='hetero',fixef.rm='none')
  b<-coef(m)[['OFFER']];s<-fixest::se(m)[['OFFER']]
  data.table(outcome=v,estimate=b,se=s,lower=b-1.96*s,upper=b+1.96*s,n=nobs(m))
}))
fwrite(error_models,file.path(rk_out,'lottery_differential_reconstruction_error.csv'))

# Aggregate only: exported plot contains binned scores, never person identifiers.
if(requireNamespace('ggplot2',quietly=TRUE)){
  bins<-rk_all[!is.na(ranking_proxy)&!is.na(reported_ranking),
    .N,by=.(admission_year=grad_year+1L,observed=20*floor(reported_ranking/20),
            reconstructed=20*floor(ranking_proxy/20))]
  plot<-ggplot2::ggplot(bins,ggplot2::aes(observed,reconstructed,size=N))+
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha=.45,color='#205f8c')+
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope=1,intercept=0,color='grey45',linewidth=.35)+
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~admission_year,ncol=3)+ggplot2::coord_equal()+
    ggplot2::scale_size_area(max_size=4,guide='none')+ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size=11)+
    ggplot2::labs(x='Recorded Ranking score',y='Reconstructed Ranking score',
      subtitle='20-point bins; circle area is proportional to the number of graduates')
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(rk_out,'ranking_validation.png'),plot,width=10,height=6.5,dpi=180)
}
knitr::kable(fread(file.path(rk_out,'ranking_reconstruction_coverage.csv')))
```

### Iterative audit and reusable NEM/Ranking reconstruction

This section preserves the first reconstruction as a comparison. Functions use
only grade histories and published conversion tables; recorded scores are used
for validation, never for fitting or selecting a different rule per student.
The official definition of a context includes both school and teaching type.

```{r f08-score-reconstruction-functions}
library(data.table)
setDTthreads(4)
score_round <- function(x,digits=0L) floor(x*10^digits+.5+1e-8)/10^digits
score_trunc <- function(x,digits=0L) floor(x*10^digits+1e-8)/10^digits
nem_from_gpa <- function(gpa,admission_year,group,tables){
  stopifnot(length(gpa)==length(admission_year),length(gpa)==length(group))
  tab<-copy(as.data.table(tables))
  tab[,grade100:=as.integer(score_round(gpa*100))]
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tab,by=c('grad_year','nem_group','grade100')))
  q<-data.table(id=seq_along(gpa),grad_year=admission_year-1L,nem_group=group,
    grade100=as.integer(score_round(gpa*100)))
  as.numeric(tab[q,on=.(grad_year,nem_group,grade100)][order(id),score])
}
nem_from_history <- function(target,tables){
  z<-copy(as.data.table(target))
  z[,gpa_from_history:=score_round(rowMeans(.SD),2L),.SDcols=paste0('gpa_',1:4)]
  z[,nem_history_proxy:=nem_from_gpa(gpa_from_history,grad_year+1L,nem_group,tables)]
  z[complete_history==FALSE,nem_history_proxy:=NA_real_]
  z[,nem_recorded:=fifelse(is.finite(reported_nem)&reported_nem>0,as.numeric(reported_nem),NA_real_)]
  z[,nem_reported_gpa_proxy:=nem_from_gpa(reported_gpa,grad_year+1L,nem_group,tables)]
  z[grad_year %in% 2022:2024 | !between(reported_gpa,4,7),nem_reported_gpa_proxy:=NA_real_]
  z[,nem_proxy:=fcoalesce(nem_reported_gpa_proxy,nem_history_proxy)]
  z[,nem_augmented:=fcoalesce(nem_recorded,nem_proxy)]
  z[,nem_source:=fcase(!is.na(nem_recorded),'Recorded',!is.na(nem_history_proxy),
    'Reconstructed from four passed annual grades',default='Unresolved')]
  z[is.na(nem_recorded) & !is.na(nem_reported_gpa_proxy),
    nem_source:='Converted from recorded two-decimal GPA']
  z[,nem_is_imputed:=is.na(nem_recorded) & !is.na(nem_augmented)]
  z[,nem_unresolved_reason:=fcase(!is.na(nem_augmented),'Available',!complete_history,
    'Incomplete/ambiguous/unordered grade history',default='Unsupported year, modality, or GPA')]
  z
}
ranking_reference_by_context <- function(wide){
  out<-list();k<-0L
  for(first in 1:4) for(last in first:4){
    z<-wide[!is.na(get(paste0('year_',last))) & get(paste0('year_',last))<=2024]
    z[,g_full:=rowMeans(.SD),.SDcols=paste0('gpa_',first:last)]
    z[,chronological:=TRUE]
    if(first<last)for(j in first:(last-1L))
      z[,chronological:=chronological & get(paste0('year_',j))<get(paste0('year_',j+1L))]
    z<-z[is.finite(g_full) & chronological==TRUE]
    z[,`:=`(g_trunc=score_trunc(g_full,2L),g_round=score_round(g_full,2L),
      rbd=get(paste0('rbd_',last)),exit_year=get(paste0('year_',last)),
      teaching=get(paste0('teaching_',last)))]
    z[,same_context:=TRUE]
    for(j in first:last)z[,same_context:=same_context &
      get(paste0('rbd_',j))==rbd & get(paste0('teaching_',j))==teaching]
    for(population in c('exit_context','same_context')){
      q<-if(population=='same_context')z[same_context==TRUE] else z
      k<-k+1L
      out[[k]]<-q[,.(n=.N,sum_trunc=sum(g_trunc),sum_round=sum(g_round),sum_full=sum(g_full),
        max_trunc=max(g_trunc),max_round=max(g_round),max_full=max(g_full)),
        by=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year)]
      out[[k]][,`:=`(first=first,last=last,population=population)]
    }
  }
  rbindlist(out)
}
ranking_student_contexts <- function(target,split_teaching=TRUE){
  out<-list();k<-0L
  for(first in 1:4)for(last in first:4){
    z<-target[complete_history==TRUE]
    same<-rep(TRUE,nrow(z))
    eq<-function(j,h)z[[paste0('rbd_',j)]]==z[[paste0('rbd_',h)]] &
      (!split_teaching | z[[paste0('teaching_',j)]]==z[[paste0('teaching_',h)]])
    for(j in first:last)same<-same & eq(j,first)
    if(first>1L)same<-same & !eq(first-1L,first)
    if(last<4L)same<-same & !eq(last+1L,first)
    z<-z[same]
    z[,g_full:=rowMeans(.SD),.SDcols=paste0('gpa_',first:last)]
    k<-k+1L
    out[[k]]<-z[,.(MRUN,grad_year,rbd=get(paste0('rbd_',last)),
      teaching=get(paste0('teaching_',last)),exit_year=get(paste0('year_',last)),
      first=first,last=last,length=last-first+1L,g_full,g_trunc=score_trunc(g_full,2L),
      g_round=score_round(g_full,2L),nem_group,
      context_group=fifelse(get(paste0('teaching_',last))==310L,'A','C'))]
  }
  ans<-rbindlist(out)
  stopifnot(ans[,all(sum(length)==4L),by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]$V1)
  ans
}
ranking_context_benchmarks <- function(contexts,annual){
  keys<-unique(contexts[,.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,first,last)])
  lagged<-rbindlist(lapply(1:3,function(lag){q<-copy(annual);q[,exit_year:=exit_year+lag];q}))
  sums<-lagged[keys,on=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,first,last),allow.cartesian=TRUE,nomatch=0][,
    .(reference_n=sum(n),reference_generations=.N,
      h_trunc_raw=sum(sum_trunc)/sum(n),h_round_raw=sum(sum_round)/sum(n),
      h_full_raw=sum(sum_full)/sum(n),h_equal_raw=mean(sum_trunc/n),
      h_equal_round_raw=mean(sum_round/n),
      h_equal_rounded_cohort_raw=mean(score_round(sum_round/n,2L)),
      h_pooled_rounded_cohort_raw=sum(score_round(sum_round/n,2L)*n)/sum(n),
      h_equal_truncated_cohort_raw=mean(score_trunc(sum_round/n,2L)),
      m_trunc_raw=mean(max_trunc),m_round_raw=mean(max_round),m_full_raw=mean(max_full)),
    by=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,first,last,population)]
  merge(contexts,sums,by=c('rbd','teaching','exit_year','first','last'),all.x=TRUE,
    allow.cartesian=TRUE)
}
ranking_from_contexts <- function(contexts,tables,own='trunc',historical='trunc',
  benchmark_precision='trunc',conversion='context',final_rounding='round',
  population='exit_context',formula='linear_grade',context_rounding='none'){
  selected_population<-population
  z<-copy(contexts[is.na(population)|population==selected_population])
  g<-z[[paste0('g_',own)]]
  h<-z[[paste0('h_',historical,'_raw')]]
  m<-z[[paste0('m_',if(historical=='equal')'trunc' else historical,'_raw')]]
  prec<-if(benchmark_precision=='round')score_round else score_trunc
  h<-prec(h,2L);m<-prec(m,2L)
  group<-if(conversion=='context')z$context_group else z$nem_group
  base<-nem_from_gpa(g,z$grad_year+1L,group,tables)
  hs<-nem_from_gpa(h,z$grad_year+1L,group,tables)
  ms<-nem_from_gpa(m,z$grad_year+1L,group,tables)
  cap<-ifelse(z$grad_year<=2021L,850,1000)
  s<-ifelse(g<=h,base,ifelse(g>=m,cap,hs+(cap-hs)*(g-h)/(m-h)))
  if(formula=='linear_score')s<-ifelse(g<=h,base,ifelse(g>=m,cap,
    hs+(cap-hs)*(base-hs)/(ms-hs)))
  s[is.na(z$reference_n)|z$reference_n<30L|!is.finite(s)|m<=h|
    !z$grad_year %in% tables$grad_year|!group %in% tables$nem_group]<-NA_real_
  if(context_rounding=='round')s<-score_round(s)
  if(context_rounding=='trunc')s<-score_trunc(s)
  z[,context_score:=s]
  a<-z[,.(unrounded=sum(context_score*length)/4,n_contexts=.N,
    min_reference_n=min(reference_n),min_generations=min(reference_generations)),by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]
  a[,ranking_calculated:=if(final_rounding=='trunc')score_trunc(unrounded) else score_round(unrounded)]
  a
}
score_metrics <- function(x){
  x<-x[is.finite(x)]
  if(!length(x))return(list(n=0L,exact=NA_real_,within_1=NA_real_,within_5=NA_real_,
    mae=NA_real_,bias=NA_real_,rmse=NA_real_))
  list(n=length(x),exact=mean(x==0),within_1=mean(abs(x)<=1),within_5=mean(abs(x)<=5),
    mae=mean(abs(x)),bias=mean(x),rmse=sqrt(mean(x^2)))
}
```

```{r f08-score-iterative-validation}
v2_input<-'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/input/f08'
v2_out<-'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking'
v2_tables<-fread(file.path(v2_out,'nem_tables_used.csv'))
v2_target<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(v2_input,'ranking_targets.rds')))
v2_target<-nem_from_history(v2_target,v2_tables)
v2_ref_path<-file.path(v2_input,'ranking_reference_modality_v2.rds')
if(!file.exists(v2_ref_path)){
  v2_wide<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(v2_input,'ranking_passed_histories.rds')))
  v2_ref<-ranking_reference_by_context(v2_wide)
  saveRDS(v2_ref,v2_ref_path);rm(v2_wide);gc()
}
v2_ref<-readRDS(v2_ref_path)
v2_context<-ranking_context_benchmarks(ranking_student_contexts(v2_target),v2_ref)
saveRDS(v2_context,file.path(v2_input,'ranking_contexts_modality_v2.rds'))
v2_specs<-data.table(variant=c('School and teaching type','Same-context reference',
  'Graduation modality table','Round own average','Round historical student averages',
  'Full historical student averages','Round historical benchmarks','Equal cohort means',
  'Truncate final score','Linear in converted NEM scores'),
  own=c('trunc','trunc','trunc','round',rep('trunc',6)),
  historical=c(rep('trunc',4),'round','full','trunc','equal','trunc','trunc'),
  benchmark_precision=c(rep('trunc',6),'round',rep('trunc',3)),
  conversion=c('context','context','graduation',rep('context',7)),
  final_rounding=c(rep('round',8),'trunc','round'),
  population=c('exit_context','same_context',rep('exit_context',8)),
  formula=c(rep('linear_grade',9),'linear_score'))
v2_old<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(v2_input,'ranking_proxy_validation.rds')))[
  reference=='exit_school',.(MRUN,grad_year,old_proxy=ranking_proxy,old_error=error)]
v2_results<-list();v2_metrics<-list()
for(i in seq_len(nrow(v2_specs))){
  spec<-as.list(v2_specs[i]);label<-spec$variant;spec$variant<-NULL
  cat('Evaluating',label,'\n')
  a<-do.call(ranking_from_contexts,c(list(contexts=v2_context,tables=v2_tables),spec))
  a<-merge(a,v2_target[,.(MRUN,grad_year,nem_history_proxy,reported_ranking,reported_nem,
    one_school,pace12,gpa_round,gpa_trunc)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
  a[,ranking_calculated:=pmax(ranking_calculated,nem_history_proxy)]
  a<-merge(a,v2_old,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
  a[,`:=`(error=ranking_calculated-reported_ranking,variant=label)]
  v2_metrics[[i]]<-a[!is.na(old_error),score_metrics(error),by=.(variant,grad_year)]
  v2_results[[i]]<-a[,.(MRUN,grad_year,variant,ranking_calculated,error)]
  if(i==1L)saveRDS(a,file.path(v2_input,'ranking_modality_validation_v2.rds'))
}
v2_validation<-rbindlist(v2_metrics)
fwrite(v2_validation,file.path(v2_out,'ranking_iterative_validation_v2.csv'))
saveRDS(rbindlist(v2_results),file.path(v2_input,'ranking_variants_v2.rds'))
fwrite(v2_specs,file.path(v2_out,'ranking_iterative_specifications_v2.csv'))
knitr::kable(v2_validation)
```

```{r f08-score-precision-audit}
# Test arithmetic conventions on the clean one-school sample. These are
# diagnostics, not permission to substitute whichever rule fits each person.
v3_tables<-fread(file.path(v2_out,'nem_tables_used.csv'))
v3_tables[,key:=(grad_year-2020L)*1000L+ifelse(nem_group=='A',0L,10000L)+as.integer(score_round(gpa*100))]
v3_lookup<-function(g,y,group){
  key<-(y-2020L)*1000L+ifelse(group=='A',0L,10000L)+as.integer(score_round(g*100))
  v3_tables$score[match(key,v3_tables$key)]
}
v3_annual<-v2_ref[population=='exit_context' & first==1L & last==4L,
  .(n=sum(n),sum_trunc=sum(sum_trunc),sum_round=sum(sum_round),sum_full=sum(sum_full),
    max_trunc=max(max_trunc),max_round=max(max_round),max_full=max(max_full)),by=.(rbd,exit_year)]
v3_raw<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(v2_input,'ranking_reference_raw_cohort_counts.rds')))[last==4L]
v3_annual<-merge(v3_annual,v3_raw[,.(rbd,exit_year=ref_year,raw_passed_n)],
  by=c('rbd','exit_year'),all.x=TRUE)
v3_lag<-rbindlist(lapply(1:3,function(lag){z<-copy(v3_annual);z[,grad_year:=exit_year+lag];z}))
v3_h<-v3_lag[,.(n_ref=sum(n),generations=.N,raw_n=sum(raw_passed_n),
  h_trunc=sum(sum_trunc)/sum(n),h_round=sum(sum_round)/sum(n),h_full=sum(sum_full)/sum(n),
  h_equal=mean(sum_trunc/n),m_trunc=mean(max_trunc),m_round=mean(max_round),m_full=mean(max_full)),
  by=.(rbd,grad_year)]
v3<-merge(v2_target[one_school==TRUE & complete_history==TRUE &
  nem_history_proxy==nem_recorded & !is.na(reported_ranking)],
  v3_h,by.x=c('rbd_4','grad_year'),by.y=c('rbd','grad_year'))
v3<-v3[n_ref==raw_n & generations==3L & n_ref>=30L]
v3<-merge(v3,v2_old,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
v3[,g_full:=rowMeans(.SD),.SDcols=paste0('gpa_',1:4)]
v3[,clean_focus:=abs(old_error)>0 & abs(old_error)<5 & abs(gpa_round-gpa_trunc)<1e-7]
v3[,audit_partition:=ifelse(rbd_4%%2L==0L,'Even RBD','Odd RBD')]
v3_cap<-ifelse(v3$grad_year<=2021L,850,1000)
v3_grid<-CJ(own=c('trunc','round','full'),historical=c('trunc','round','full'),
  h_precision=c('trunc','round','full'),m_precision=c('trunc','round','full'),
  final_rounding=c('round','trunc'))
v3_precision<-function(x,how) switch(how,trunc=score_trunc(x,2L),round=score_round(x,2L),full=x)
v3_grid_metrics<-list()
for(i in seq_len(nrow(v3_grid))){
  spec<-v3_grid[i]
  g<-switch(spec$own,trunc=v3$gpa_trunc,round=v3$gpa_round,full=v3$g_full)
  h<-v3_precision(v3[[paste0('h_',spec$historical)]],spec$h_precision)
  m<-v3_precision(v3[[paste0('m_',spec$historical)]],spec$m_precision)
  # For non-two-decimal historical means this diagnostic uses the nearest
  # published NEM cell; a full-precision benchmark is not an official assertion.
  hs<-v3_lookup(h,v3$grad_year,v3$nem_group)
  base<-v3_lookup(g,v3$grad_year,v3$nem_group)
  s<-ifelse(g<=h,base,ifelse(g>=m,v3_cap,hs+(v3_cap-hs)*(g-h)/(m-h)))
  s<-if(spec$final_rounding=='trunc')score_trunc(s) else score_round(s)
  e<-pmax(s,v3$nem_history_proxy)-v3$reported_ranking
  d<-data.table(error=e,admission_year=v3$grad_year+1L,partition=v3$audit_partition,
    clean_focus=v3$clean_focus)
  ans<-d[,score_metrics(error),by=.(admission_year,partition,clean_focus)]
  v3_grid_metrics[[i]]<-cbind(spec[rep(1L,nrow(ans))],ans)
}
v3_grid_metrics<-rbindlist(v3_grid_metrics)
fwrite(v3_grid_metrics,file.path(v2_out,'ranking_precision_grid_clean_sample.csv'))
v3_order<-v3_grid_metrics[,.(n=sum(n),exact=weighted.mean(exact,n),
  mae=weighted.mean(mae,n),focus_exact=weighted.mean(exact[clean_focus],n[clean_focus])),
  by=names(v3_grid)][order(-exact)]
fwrite(v3_order,file.path(v2_out,'ranking_precision_grid_summary.csv'))
saveRDS(v3,file.path(v2_input,'ranking_clean_precision_audit.rds'))
print(head(v3_order,15L))
```

```{r f08-ranking-historical-gpa-reconciliation}
# Use additional, earlier academic information to audit historical benchmarks.
# No current or historical Ranking score is an input. Historical NEM can identify
# a two-decimal graduation GPA where the harmonized GPA column lost precision.
hg_path<-file.path(v2_input,'historical_official_gpa.rds')
if(!file.exists(hg_path)){
  cold<-file.path(v2_input,'student_columns')
  meta<-jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(cold,'metadata.json'),simplifyVector=FALSE)$value
  projection<-jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(v2_out,'..','student_column_projection.json'),simplifyVector=FALSE)
  needed<-c('year','mrun','egreso_yyyy','promedio_notas','nem')
  cols<-lapply(needed,function(nm){
    index<-as.integer(names(projection)[vapply(projection,identical,logical(1),nm)])+1L
    readBin(file.path(cold,paste0(nm,'.bin')),if(meta[[index]]$type==14L)'double' else 'integer',
      n=meta[[index]]$n,endian='big')
  });names(cols)<-needed
  hg<-as.data.table(cols);rm(cols)
  hg<-hg[year>=2011 & year<=2025 & egreso_yyyy==year-1L & mrun>0,
    .(MRUN=mrun,grad_year=as.integer(egreso_yyyy),admission_year=as.integer(year),
      raw_official_gpa=promedio_notas,reported_nem=nem)]
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(hg,by=c('MRUN','grad_year')))
  w<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(v2_input,'ranking_passed_histories.rds')))
  hg<-merge(hg,w[,.(MRUN,actual_grad_year=year_4,teaching_4)],by='MRUN')
  hg<-hg[grad_year==actual_grad_year]
  hg[,nem_group:=fifelse(teaching_4==310L,'A','C')]
  inv<-copy(v2_tables);setnames(inv,c('score','gpa'),c('reported_nem','gpa_implied_by_nem'))
  hg<-merge(hg,inv[,.(grad_year,nem_group,reported_nem,gpa_implied_by_nem)],
    by=c('grad_year','nem_group','reported_nem'),all.x=TRUE)
  hg[,official_gpa:=fifelse(admission_year<=2022 & between(raw_official_gpa,4,7),
    score_round(raw_official_gpa,2L),gpa_implied_by_nem)]
  hg[,gpa_source:=fifelse(admission_year<=2022,'Recorded graduation GPA','Inverse official NEM table')]
  saveRDS(hg,file.path(v2_input,'historical_official_gpa.rds'))
}
hg<-copy(readRDS(hg_path))
# Earlier harmonized GPA fields do not preserve two-decimal precision; they
# cannot repair historical grades. Current full-course benchmarks use 2017+.
hg[admission_year<2016L,official_gpa:=NA_real_]
w<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(v2_input,'ranking_passed_histories.rds')))

w[,grade_gpa:=score_round(rowMeans(.SD),2L),.SDcols=paste0('gpa_',1:4)]
w[,ordered_history:=year_1<year_2 & year_2<year_3 & year_3<year_4]
w[is.na(ordered_history)|ordered_history==FALSE,grade_gpa:=NA_real_]
w<-merge(w,hg[,.(MRUN,year_4=grad_year,official_gpa,gpa_source)],by=c('MRUN','year_4'),all.x=TRUE)
w[,historical_gpa:=fcoalesce(official_gpa,grade_gpa)]
fwrite(w[,.(n=.N,official_available=sum(!is.na(official_gpa)),
  comparison_n=sum(!is.na(official_gpa)&!is.na(grade_gpa)),
  exact=mean(abs(official_gpa-grade_gpa)<1e-7,na.rm=TRUE),
  changed=sum(abs(official_gpa-grade_gpa)>1e-7,na.rm=TRUE),
  recovered=sum(is.na(grade_gpa)&!is.na(official_gpa))),by=year_4],
  file.path(v2_out,'historical_gpa_reconciliation.csv'))
hg_ref<-w[!is.na(historical_gpa),.(n=.N,sum_trunc=sum(historical_gpa),sum_round=sum(historical_gpa),
  sum_full=sum(historical_gpa),max_trunc=max(historical_gpa),max_round=max(historical_gpa),
  max_full=max(historical_gpa)),by=.(rbd=rbd_4,teaching=teaching_4,exit_year=year_4)]
hg_ref[,`:=`(first=1L,last=4L,population='exit_context')]

saveRDS(hg_ref,file.path(v2_input,'ranking_reference_historical_gpa_v5.rds'))

  if(grouping=='school')r[,teaching:=0L] else {
    r[,teaching:=ifelse(teaching==310L,310L,410L)]
    for(j in 1:4)set(t,j=paste0('teaching_',j),value=ifelse(t[[paste0('teaching_',j)]]==310L,310L,410L))
  }
  r<-r[,.(n=sum(n),sum_trunc=sum(sum_trunc),sum_round=sum(sum_round),sum_full=sum(sum_full),
    max_trunc=max(max_trunc),max_round=max(max_round),max_full=max(max_full)),
    by=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,first,last,population)]
  c<-ranking_student_contexts(t,split_teaching=grouping!='school')

  a<-merge(a,v2_target[,.(MRUN,grad_year,nem_history_proxy,reported_ranking,reported_nem,
    one_school,pace12,gpa_round,gpa_trunc,RBD)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
  a[,ranking_calculated:=pmax(ranking_calculated,nem_history_proxy)]
  a<-merge(a,v2_old,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
  a[,`:=`(error=ranking_calculated-reported_ranking,variant=paste0('historical_gpa_',grouping))]
  hg_metrics[[grouping]]<-a[!is.na(old_error),score_metrics(error),by=.(variant,grad_year,pace12)]
  hg_scores[[grouping]]<-a[,.(MRUN,grad_year,variant,ranking_calculated,error)]
}
```

```{r f08-ranking-scale-transformation-audit}
# Check whether the 2023 scale change was applied before or after rounding
# the NEM anchor used for the Ranking line. This is separate from NEM itself.
scale_rows<-function(lines,k){
  pat<-paste0('^[4-7](,[0-9]{1,2})?',paste(rep(' [0-9]+',k-1L),collapse=''),'$')
  mat<-do.call(rbind,strsplit(grep(pat,trimws(lines),value=TRUE),' +'))
  as.data.table(matrix(as.numeric(gsub(',','.',mat,fixed=TRUE)),ncol=k))
}
scale_sources<-file.path(v2_out,'..','sources','ranking')
scale_a<-unique(scale_rows(readLines(file.path(scale_sources,'demre_nem_a_2019_archive.txt')),7L))
setnames(scale_a,c('gpa',as.character(2018:2023)))
ll<-readLines(file.path(scale_sources,'mineduc_access_tables_2020.txt'))
scale_c<-unique(scale_rows(ll[(which(ll=='--- PAGE 18 ---')+1L):length(ll)],5L))
setnames(scale_c,c('gpa',as.character(2020:2023)))
scale_old<-rbind(scale_a[,.(gpa,nem_group='A',old_score=get('2023'))],
  scale_c[,.(gpa,nem_group='C',old_score=get('2023'))])
scale_old[,unrounded_paes:=100+(old_score-150)*900/700]
scale_check<-merge(scale_old,v2_tables[grad_year==2022,.(gpa,nem_group,score)],by=c('gpa','nem_group'))
fwrite(scale_check[,.(cells=.N,exact_after_rounding=mean(score_round(unrounded_paes)==score),
  max_difference=max(abs(score_round(unrounded_paes)-score))),by=nem_group],
  file.path(v2_out,'ranking_scale_anchor_validation.csv'))
scale_tables<-merge(copy(v2_tables),scale_old[,.(gpa,nem_group,unrounded_paes)],
  by=c('gpa','nem_group'),all.x=TRUE)
scale_tables[,score:=as.numeric(score)]
scale_tables[grad_year>=2022,score:=unrounded_paes]
scale_metrics<-list();scale_scores<-list()
for(grouping in c('school','broad_modality')){
  c<-readRDS(file.path(v2_input,paste0('ranking_contexts_historical_gpa_',grouping,'.rds')))
  a<-ranking_from_contexts(c,scale_tables,own='round',historical='round',
    benchmark_precision='round',conversion=if(grouping=='school')'graduation' else 'context')
  a<-merge(a,v2_target[,.(MRUN,grad_year,nem_history_proxy,reported_ranking,reported_nem,
    one_school,pace12,gpa_round,gpa_trunc,RBD)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
  a[,ranking_calculated:=pmax(ranking_calculated,nem_history_proxy)]
  a<-merge(a,v2_old,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
  a[,`:=`(error=ranking_calculated-reported_ranking,variant=paste0('unrounded_scale_',grouping))]
  scale_metrics[[grouping]]<-a[!is.na(old_error),score_metrics(error),by=.(variant,grad_year,pace12)]
  scale_scores[[grouping]]<-a[,.(MRUN,grad_year,variant,ranking_calculated,error)]
}
scale_metrics<-rbindlist(scale_metrics);scale_scores<-rbindlist(scale_scores)
fwrite(scale_metrics,file.path(v2_out,'ranking_scale_anchor_sensitivity.csv'))
saveRDS(scale_scores,file.path(v2_input,'ranking_scale_anchor_candidates.rds'))
print(scale_metrics[,.(n=sum(n),exact=weighted.mean(exact,n),mae=weighted.mean(mae,n)),by=variant])
```

```{r f08-ranking-remaining-discrepancies}
  by=.(grad_year,one_school,stable_modality,on_schedule,nem_match,reported_grad_matches)],
  file.path(v2_out,'ranking_refined_history_diagnostics.csv'))
common<-remaining[!is.na(old_error)&!is.na(error)]
fwrite(rbindlist(list(common[,c(list(method='Original'),score_metrics(old_error)),by=grad_year],
  common[,c(list(method='Rounded broad-modality historical-GPA proxy'),score_metrics(error)),by=grad_year])),
  file.path(v2_out,'ranking_refined_common_sample_comparison.csv'))

# Test whether the recorded outcome is even single-valued in the complete set
# of observed inputs for a one-context student. No fitted score is used to fill
# any record. Conflicting cells expose information absent from this reconstruction.
cells<-remaining[one_school==TRUE & stable_modality==TRUE & nem_match==TRUE &
  on_schedule==TRUE & reported_grad_matches==TRUE & !is.na(reported_ranking),
  .(n=.N,distinct_scores=uniqueN(reported_ranking),minimum=min(reported_ranking),
    maximum=max(reported_ranking),best_single_score_matches=max(tabulate(match(reported_ranking,
      unique(reported_ranking))))),by=.(rbd_4,grad_year,nem_group,gpa_round)]
fwrite(cells[,.(students=sum(n),gpa_cells=.N,conflicting_cells=sum(distinct_scores>1L),
  students_in_conflicting_cells=sum(n[distinct_scores>1L]),
  minimum_unavoidable_mismatches=sum(n-best_single_score_matches)),by=grad_year],
  file.path(v2_out,'ranking_identical_input_conflicts.csv'))
# Report only aggregate group sizes, never identifying cell details.
saveRDS(cells,file.path(v2_input,'ranking_identical_input_cells.rds'))
clean<-readRDS(file.path(v2_input,'ranking_clean_precision_audit.rds'))
clean_results<-merge(clean[,.(MRUN,grad_year,clean_focus,audit_partition)],
  remaining[,.(MRUN,grad_year,error)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'))
fwrite(clean_results[,score_metrics(error),by=.(grad_year,clean_focus,audit_partition)],
  file.path(v2_out,'ranking_refined_clean_sample_validation.csv'))
saveRDS(remaining,file.path(v2_input,'ranking_refined_validation_records.rds'))
print(common[,c(list(method='Original'),score_metrics(old_error))])
print(common[,c(list(method='Refined proxy'),score_metrics(error))])
print(clean_results[clean_focus==TRUE,score_metrics(error)])
print(cells[,.(students=sum(n),minimum_unavoidable_mismatches=sum(n-best_single_score_matches))])
```

```{r f08-ranking-cohort-averaging-audit}
# A historical mean can differ depending on whether annual cohort summaries
# were averaged equally, weighted by cohort size, or rounded before averaging.
avg_ref<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(v2_input,'ranking_reference_historical_gpa_v5.rds')))
avg_ref[,teaching:=ifelse(teaching==310L,310L,410L)]
avg_ref<-avg_ref[,.(n=sum(n),sum_trunc=sum(sum_trunc),sum_round=sum(sum_round),sum_full=sum(sum_full),
  max_trunc=max(max_trunc),max_round=max(max_round),max_full=max(max_full)),
  by=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,first,last,population)]
avg_target<-copy(v2_target)
for(j in 1:4)set(avg_target,j=paste0('teaching_',j),value=ifelse(avg_target[[paste0('teaching_',j)]]==310L,310L,410L))
avg_context<-ranking_context_benchmarks(ranking_student_contexts(avg_target),avg_ref)
saveRDS(avg_context,file.path(v2_input,'ranking_contexts_cohort_averaging.rds'))
avg_scores<-list();avg_metrics<-list()
for(method in c('h_round_raw','h_equal_round_raw','h_equal_rounded_cohort_raw',
  'h_pooled_rounded_cohort_raw','h_equal_truncated_cohort_raw')){
  cat('Historical mean:',method,'\n')
  c<-copy(avg_context);c[,h_round_raw:=get(method)]
  a<-ranking_from_contexts(c,v2_tables,own='round',historical='round',benchmark_precision='round')
  a<-merge(a,v2_target[,.(MRUN,grad_year,nem_history_proxy,reported_ranking,pace12)],
    by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
  a[,ranking_calculated:=pmax(ranking_calculated,nem_history_proxy)]
  a<-merge(a,v2_old,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
  a[,`:=`(error=ranking_calculated-reported_ranking,variant=method)]
  avg_metrics[[method]]<-a[!is.na(old_error),score_metrics(error),by=.(variant,grad_year,pace12)]
  avg_scores[[method]]<-a[,.(MRUN,grad_year,variant,ranking_calculated,error)]
}
avg_metrics<-rbindlist(avg_metrics);avg_scores<-rbindlist(avg_scores)
fwrite(avg_metrics,file.path(v2_out,'ranking_cohort_averaging_validation.csv'))
saveRDS(avg_scores,file.path(v2_input,'ranking_cohort_averaging_candidates.rds'))
print(avg_metrics[,.(n=sum(n),exact=weighted.mean(exact,n),mae=weighted.mean(mae,n)),by=variant])
```

# One uniform candidate is retained; never choose a rule separately for each

  final_candidate,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)

final[,ranking_recorded:=as.numeric(reported_ranking)]
final[,ranking_augmented_refined:=fcoalesce(ranking_recorded,ranking_proxy_refined)]
final[,ranking_is_imputed:=is.na(ranking_recorded)&!is.na(ranking_augmented_refined)]

  'Provisional rounded-cohort reconstruction',default='Unresolved')]

  !complete_history,'Incomplete/ambiguous/unordered passed-grade history',
  default='Missing, small, or degenerate historical context')]

final[,reconstruction_version:='2026-10-19 iterative rounded-cohort candidate; precision rule unresolved']
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(final,by=c('MRUN','grad_year')),
  final[!is.na(ranking_recorded),all(ranking_augmented_refined==ranking_recorded)],
  final[!is.na(nem_recorded),all(nem_augmented==nem_recorded)],
  final[!is.na(ranking_proxy_refined),all(ranking_proxy_refined>=nem_history_proxy)],
  final[!is.na(ranking_proxy_refined),all(ranking_proxy_refined<=ifelse(grad_year<=2021,850,1000))])

  ranking_unresolved=sum(is.na(ranking_augmented_refined))),by=.(admission_year=grad_year+1L)]
setorder(score_coverage,admission_year)
