## Follow-up: remaining score discrepancies by year and context

The following diagnostics use the delivered rounded-cohort candidate. They do
not overwrite score imputations or manuscript estimates. Admission year is
school graduation year plus one; calendar-year and cohort effects are descriptive.

```{r f08-score-followup-patterns}
library(data.table)
setDTthreads(4)
fu_input <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/input/f08'
fu_out <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/followup_2026-10-19'
dir.create(fu_out, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
fu_tables <- fread('analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/nem_tables_used.csv')
fu_scores <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'score_reconstruction_records.rds')))
fu_target <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'ranking_targets.rds')))
fu <- merge(fu_scores,fu_target[,c('MRUN','grad_year','minimum_ranking','reported_gpa',
 'reported_grad_year','one_school',paste0('year_',1:4),paste0('rbd_',1:4),
 paste0('teaching_',1:4),paste0('gpa_',1:4)),with=FALSE],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'))
stopifnot(nrow(fu)==1286127L,!anyDuplicated(fu,by=c('MRUN','grad_year')))
fu[,`:=`(admission_year=grad_year+1L,nem_error=nem_history_proxy-nem_recorded,
 ranking_error=ranking_proxy_refined-ranking_recorded,
 common_old=!is.na(old_proxy)&!is.na(ranking_proxy_refined)&!is.na(ranking_recorded),
 regular_progress=year_1==grad_year-3L & year_2==grad_year-2L & year_3==grad_year-1L,
 stable_modality=(teaching_1==310L)==(teaching_2==310L) &
 (teaching_2==310L)==(teaching_3==310L) & (teaching_3==310L)==(teaching_4==310L))]
fu[,nem_exact:=nem_error==0]
fu[,recorded_bonus:=fcase(is.na(ranking_recorded)|is.na(nem_recorded),'Unavailable',
 ranking_recorded==nem_recorded,'At NEM floor',ranking_recorded>nem_recorded,'Above NEM floor',
 default='Below NEM')]
fu_context <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'ranking_contexts_cohort_averaging.rds')))
fu_context <- fu_context[population=='exit_context']
fu_ref <- fu_context[,.(min_reference_n=min(reference_n),min_generations=min(reference_generations),
 max_generations=max(reference_generations),context_count=.N,
 min_h= min(h_equal_rounded_cohort_raw),max_m=max(m_round_raw)),by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]
fu <- merge(fu,fu_ref,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
fu[,reference_size:=cut(min_reference_n,c(-Inf,29,59,149,299,Inf),
 labels=c('<30','30-59','60-149','150-299','300+'))]
fu[,clean_one_context:=n_contexts==1L & nem_exact==TRUE & regular_progress==TRUE &
 min_generations==3L & complete_history==TRUE]
fu_metrics <- function(e){
 e<-e[is.finite(e)];n<-length(e)
 if(!n)return(list(n=0L,mismatches=0L,exact=NA_real_,within1=NA_real_,within5=NA_real_,
  mae=NA_real_,bias=NA_real_,over=NA_real_,under=NA_real_,p95=NA_real_,large_errors=0L,total_abs_error=0))
 list(n=n,mismatches=sum(e!=0),exact=mean(e==0),within1=mean(abs(e)<=1),within5=mean(abs(e)<=5),
 mae=mean(abs(e)),bias=mean(e),over=mean(e>0),under=mean(e<0),p95=as.numeric(quantile(abs(e),.95)),
 large_errors=sum(abs(e)>5),total_abs_error=sum(abs(e)))
}
fu_year<-rbindlist(lapply(c('nem_error','ranking_error'),function(v)
 fu[,c(list(score=v),fu_metrics(get(v))),by=admission_year]))
fu_year[,`:=`(share_all_mismatches=mismatches/sum(mismatches),
 share_all_large_errors=large_errors/sum(large_errors),
 share_total_absolute_error=total_abs_error/sum(total_abs_error)),by=score]
setorder(fu_year,score,admission_year)
fwrite(fu_year,file.path(fu_out,'year_accuracy.csv'))
fwrite(fu[common_old==TRUE,fu_metrics(ranking_error),by=admission_year],
 file.path(fu_out,'year_common_sample_accuracy.csv'))
fu_groups<-list()
for(v in c('nem_error','ranking_error'))for(g in c('pace12','nem_group','teaching_4','n_contexts',
 'regular_progress','stable_modality','nem_exact','recorded_bonus','reference_size','min_generations',
 'clean_one_context')){
 a<-fu[,fu_metrics(get(v)),by=c('admission_year',g)]
 setnames(a,g,'group_value');a[,group_value:=as.character(group_value)]
 a[,`:=`(score=v,group_variable=g)];fu_groups[[paste(v,g)]]<-a
}
fu_groups<-rbindlist(fu_groups,use.names=TRUE)
fwrite(fu_groups,file.path(fu_out,'year_group_accuracy.csv'))
fwrite(fu[,fu_metrics(ranking_error),by=.(admission_year,pace12,nem_group,n_contexts,nem_exact)],
 file.path(fu_out,'year_pace_modality_context_accuracy.csv'))
fwrite(fu[,.(graduates=.N,nem_observed=sum(!is.na(nem_recorded)),
 nem_reconstructible=sum(!is.na(nem_history_proxy)),nem_both=sum(is.finite(nem_error)),
 ranking_observed=sum(!is.na(ranking_recorded)),ranking_reconstructible=sum(!is.na(ranking_proxy_refined)),
 ranking_both=sum(is.finite(ranking_error)),nem_missing_filled=sum(nem_is_imputed),
 ranking_missing_filled=sum(ranking_is_imputed)),by=.(admission_year,pace12)],
 file.path(fu_out,'year_coverage.csv'))
# Aggregated concentration, with no school IDs in released files.
fu_school<-fu[is.finite(ranking_error),.(n=.N,bad=sum(ranking_error!=0),
 large=sum(abs(ranking_error)>5),abs_sum=sum(abs(ranking_error)),mean_error=mean(ranking_error)),
 by=.(RBD,admission_year,pace12)]
fu_concentration<-rbindlist(lapply(c(.01,.05,.1,.2),function(q){
 z<-copy(fu_school);setorder(z,admission_year,-abs_sum)
 z[,top:=seq_len(.N)<=ceiling(.N*q),by=admission_year]
 z[,.(top_school_share=q,school_cohorts=.N,selected=sum(top),
 student_share=sum(n[top])/sum(n),mismatch_share=sum(bad[top])/sum(bad),
 large_error_share=sum(large[top])/sum(large),absolute_error_share=sum(abs_sum[top])/sum(abs_sum)),
 by=admission_year]
}))
fwrite(fu_concentration,file.path(fu_out,'year_school_error_concentration.csv'))
# Rule-stage diagnostics only: never use recorded NEM as a predictor for imputation.
fu[,floor_with_recorded_nem_error:=pmax(ranking_proxy_refined,nem_recorded)-ranking_recorded]
fwrite(fu[is.finite(ranking_error)&is.finite(nem_error),
 .(n=.N,ranking_exact=mean(ranking_error==0),nem_exact=mean(nem_error==0),
 ranking_exact_if_floor_recorded_nem=mean(floor_with_recorded_nem_error==0),
 mismatches_resolved_by_floor=sum(ranking_error!=0 & floor_with_recorded_nem_error==0)),
 by=.(admission_year,pace12)],file.path(fu_out,'nem_floor_diagnostic.csv'))
# NEM-inverted GPA is a diagnostic outcome, not an independent candidate.
fu_inv<-fu_tables[,.(grad_year,nem_group,nem_recorded=score,official_gpa_from_nem=gpa)]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(fu_inv,by=c('grad_year','nem_group','nem_recorded')))
fu<-merge(fu,fu_inv,by=c('grad_year','nem_group','nem_recorded'),all.x=TRUE)
fu[,gpa_difference_hundredths:=round(100*(gpa_from_history-official_gpa_from_nem))]
fwrite(fu[is.finite(nem_error),.N,by=.(admission_year,pace12,nem_exact,
 gpa_difference_hundredths)],file.path(fu_out,'nem_implied_gpa_differences.csv'))
# Offer comparisons are conditional validation, not causal effects in always-observed students.
fu_panel<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'pace_finalized_panel.rds')))
fu_lottery<-merge(fu_panel[,.(MRUN,grad_year,YEAR,CHANCE_GROUP,OFFER)],
 fu[,.(MRUN,grad_year,ranking_error,nem_error,ranking_recorded,ranking_proxy_refined,minimum_ranking)],
 by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
fwrite(fu_lottery[,c(list(score='Ranking'),fu_metrics(ranking_error)),by=.(YEAR,OFFER)],
 file.path(fu_out,'lottery_offer_validation.csv'))
saveRDS(fu,file.path(fu_input,'score_followup_diagnostic_records_2026-10-19.rds'))
fwrite(data.table(input=c('score_reconstruction_records.rds','ranking_targets.rds',
 'ranking_contexts_cohort_averaging.rds','pace_finalized_panel.rds'),
 md5=unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(fu_input,c('score_reconstruction_records.rds','ranking_targets.rds',
 'ranking_contexts_cohort_averaging.rds','pace_finalized_panel.rds'))))),file.path(fu_out,'input_provenance.csv'))
print(fu_year)
print(fu[common_old==TRUE,fu_metrics(ranking_error),by=pace12])
print(fu[is.finite(ranking_error),fu_metrics(ranking_error),by=.(pace12,nem_group,n_contexts)])
```

```{r f08-score-followup-context-hypothesis}
# Test the data-driven hypothesis of a within-school HC-to-TP transition.
# Uniform rules use observed histories only; neither Ranking nor PACE status
# selects a person's rule. Existing delivered scores remain unchanged.
fu_input <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/input/f08'
fu_out <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/followup_2026-10-19'
fu_tables <- fread('analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/nem_tables_used.csv')
fu <- readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'score_followup_diagnostic_records_2026-10-19.rds'))
fu_target <- nem_from_history(as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'ranking_targets.rds'))),fu_tables)
for(j in 1:4)set(fu_target,j=paste0('teaching_',j),
 value=ifelse(fu_target[[paste0('teaching_',j)]]==310L,310L,410L))
fu_annual <- copy(readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'ranking_reference_historical_gpa_v5.rds')))
fu_annual[,teaching:=ifelse(teaching==310L,310L,410L)]
fu_annual<-fu_annual[,.(n=sum(n),sum_trunc=sum(sum_trunc),sum_round=sum(sum_round),
 sum_full=sum(sum_full),max_trunc=max(max_trunc),max_round=max(max_round),max_full=max(max_full)),
 by=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,first,last,population)]
# Combine contiguous years at the same school; retain final context's modality
# when choosing historical peers and conversion table, rather than pooling HC/TP.
fu_school_context<-ranking_context_benchmarks(
 ranking_student_contexts(fu_target,split_teaching=FALSE),fu_annual)
fu_school_context[,h_round_raw:=h_equal_rounded_cohort_raw]
fu_school_candidate<-ranking_from_contexts(fu_school_context,fu_tables,own='round',
 historical='round',benchmark_precision='round',context_rounding='round')
setnames(fu_school_candidate,'ranking_calculated','school_context_candidate')
fu_hyp<-merge(fu,fu_school_candidate[,.(MRUN,grad_year,school_context_candidate)],
 by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
fu_hyp[,school_context_candidate:=pmax(school_context_candidate,nem_history_proxy)]
fu_hyp[,pattern:=paste(ifelse(teaching_1==310,'H','T'),ifelse(teaching_2==310,'H','T'),
 ifelse(teaching_3==310,'H','T'),ifelse(teaching_4==310,'H','T'),sep='')]
fu_hyp[,target_transition:=one_school==TRUE & pattern=='HHTT']
fu_hyp[,targeted_candidate:=fifelse(target_transition==TRUE,
 school_context_candidate,ranking_proxy_refined)]
fu_hyp[,`:=`(school_error=school_context_candidate-ranking_recorded,
 targeted_error=targeted_candidate-ranking_recorded)]
fu_hyp_results<-rbindlist(lapply(c('ranking_error','school_error','targeted_error'),function(v){
 z<-fu_hyp[is.finite(ranking_error)&is.finite(school_error)]
 rbindlist(list(z[,c(list(variant=v,group='All'),fu_metrics(get(v))),by=admission_year],
 z[,c(list(variant=v),fu_metrics(get(v))),by=.(admission_year,group=paste0('PACE=',pace12))],
 z[,c(list(variant=v),fu_metrics(get(v))),by=.(admission_year,group=paste0('Target transition=',target_transition))]),use.names=TRUE)
}),use.names=TRUE)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(fu_hyp_results,by=c('admission_year','variant','group')),
 fu_hyp_results[group=='All',all(n<=200000L)],
 all(fu_hyp_results$variant %in% c('ranking_error','school_error','targeted_error')))
fwrite(fu_hyp_results,file.path(fu_out,'context_hypothesis_same_sample.csv'))
fwrite(fu_hyp[,.(total=.N,old_available=sum(is.finite(ranking_proxy_refined)),
 school_available=sum(is.finite(school_context_candidate)),
 gained=sum(!is.finite(ranking_proxy_refined)&is.finite(school_context_candidate)),
 lost=sum(is.finite(ranking_proxy_refined)&!is.finite(school_context_candidate))),
 by=.(admission_year,pace12,target_transition)],file.path(fu_out,'context_hypothesis_coverage.csv'))
fwrite(fu_hyp[is.finite(ranking_error)&is.finite(school_error),
 .(n=.N,old_mismatches=sum(ranking_error!=0),new_mismatches=sum(school_error!=0),
 resolved=sum(ranking_error!=0 & school_error==0),introduced=sum(ranking_error==0 & school_error!=0),
 improved=sum(abs(school_error)<abs(ranking_error)),worsened=sum(abs(school_error)>abs(ranking_error))),
 by=.(admission_year,pace12,target_transition)],file.path(fu_out,'context_hypothesis_transitions.csv'))
fwrite(fu_hyp[is.finite(ranking_error),fu_metrics(ranking_error),
 by=.(admission_year,pace12,one_school,pattern)],file.path(fu_out,'year_curriculum_sequence_accuracy.csv'))
saveRDS(fu_hyp[,.(MRUN,grad_year,ranking_proxy_refined,school_context_candidate,
 targeted_candidate,target_transition,pattern)],
 file.path(fu_input,'ranking_context_hypothesis_2026-10-19.rds'))
# Fit comparison is retrospective and does not certify the historical official rule.
print(fu_hyp[is.finite(ranking_error)&is.finite(school_error),
 .(n=.N,old_exact=mean(ranking_error==0),new_exact=mean(school_error==0),
 old_mae=mean(abs(ranking_error)),new_mae=mean(abs(school_error))),by=.(pace12,target_transition)])
print(fu_hyp_results[group=='All'])
```

```{r f08-score-followup-validation}
# Re-read saved candidates so validation does not depend on transient objects.
fu_input <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/input/f08'
fu_out <- 'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/followup_2026-10-19'
fu<-readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'score_followup_diagnostic_records_2026-10-19.rds'))
hyp<-readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'ranking_context_hypothesis_2026-10-19.rds'))
hyp[,ranking_proxy_refined:=NULL]
fu<-merge(fu,hyp,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
fu[,candidate_error:=targeted_candidate-ranking_recorded]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(fu,by=c('MRUN','grad_year')),
 fu[is.finite(targeted_candidate),all(targeted_candidate>=nem_history_proxy)],
 fu[is.finite(targeted_candidate),all(targeted_candidate<=ifelse(grad_year<=2021L,850,1000))])
fu[,comparison_sample:=is.finite(ranking_error)&is.finite(candidate_error)]
fu_validation<-rbindlist(lapply(c('ranking_error','candidate_error'),function(v){
 z<-fu[comparison_sample==TRUE]
 rbindlist(list(z[,c(list(variant=v,group='All'),fu_metrics(get(v))),by=admission_year],
 z[,c(list(variant=v),fu_metrics(get(v))),by=.(admission_year,group=paste0('PACE=',pace12))]),use.names=TRUE)
}),use.names=TRUE)
fwrite(fu_validation,file.path(fu_out,'targeted_candidate_validation.csv'))
fwrite(fu[comparison_sample==TRUE,fu_metrics(candidate_error),
 by=.(admission_year,pace12,nem_group,target_transition,nem_exact,min_generations,reference_size)],
 file.path(fu_out,'targeted_candidate_residual_groups.csv'))
fwrite(fu[comparison_sample==TRUE,.(n=.N,old_errors=sum(ranking_error!=0),
 candidate_errors=sum(candidate_error!=0),resolved=sum(ranking_error!=0&candidate_error==0),
 introduced=sum(ranking_error==0&candidate_error!=0),
 old_abs_error=sum(abs(ranking_error)),candidate_abs_error=sum(abs(candidate_error))),
 by=.(admission_year,target_transition)],file.path(fu_out,'targeted_candidate_changes.csv'))
fu_cutoffs<-rbindlist(lapply(c('ranking_proxy_refined','targeted_candidate'),function(v){
 fu[comparison_sample==TRUE,.(variant=v,n=.N,
 observed_above=sum(ranking_recorded>=minimum_ranking),
 false_positive=sum(get(v)>=minimum_ranking & ranking_recorded<minimum_ranking),
 false_negative=sum(get(v)<minimum_ranking & ranking_recorded>=minimum_ranking),
 agreement=mean((get(v)>=minimum_ranking)==(ranking_recorded>=minimum_ranking))),
 by=.(admission_year,pace12,near_cutoff=abs(ranking_recorded-minimum_ranking)<=10)]
}),use.names=TRUE)
fwrite(fu_cutoffs,file.path(fu_out,'targeted_candidate_absolute_threshold.csv'))
# Preserve unknown scores; do not redefine the PACE percentile population.
stopifnot(fu[target_transition!=TRUE|is.na(target_transition),
 all(is.na(targeted_candidate)==is.na(ranking_proxy_refined))],
 fu[target_transition==FALSE & is.finite(targeted_candidate),
 all(targeted_candidate==ranking_proxy_refined)])
# Differential measurement diagnostics on observed-score graduates, conditional on
# the original offer-probability and year strata. This is not a mechanism effect.
fp<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'pace_finalized_panel.rds')))
fl<-merge(fp[,.(MRUN,grad_year,YEAR,CHANCE_GROUP,OFFER)],
 fu[,.(MRUN,grad_year,nem_error,ranking_error,candidate_error,minimum_ranking,
 ranking_recorded,ranking_proxy_refined,targeted_candidate)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
fl[,`:=`(old_valid=is.finite(ranking_error),new_valid=is.finite(candidate_error),
 old_mismatch=as.numeric(ranking_error!=0),new_mismatch=as.numeric(candidate_error!=0))]
fdi<-rbindlist(lapply(c('old_valid','new_valid','old_mismatch','new_mismatch','ranking_error','candidate_error'),function(v){
 fit<-fixest::feols(as.formula(paste(v,'~ OFFER | CHANCE_GROUP + YEAR')),data=fl,vcov='hetero',notes=FALSE)
 data.table(outcome=v,n=stats::nobs(fit),offer_coefficient=stats::coef(fit)[['OFFER']],
 se=fixest::se(fit)[['OFFER']],p=fixest::pvalue(fit)[['OFFER']])
}))
fl_common<-fl[old_valid & new_valid]
fdi_common<-rbindlist(lapply(c('old_mismatch','new_mismatch','ranking_error','candidate_error'),function(v){
 fit<-fixest::feols(as.formula(paste(v,'~ OFFER | CHANCE_GROUP + YEAR')),data=fl_common,vcov='hetero',notes=FALSE)
 data.table(outcome=v,n=stats::nobs(fit),offer_coefficient=stats::coef(fit)[['OFFER']],
 se=fixest::se(fit)[['OFFER']],p=fixest::pvalue(fit)[['OFFER']])
}))
fwrite(fdi,file.path(fu_out,'offer_differential_validation.csv'))
fwrite(fdi_common,file.path(fu_out,'offer_differential_common_sample.csv'))

# Repeated registrations: compare independently reconstructed GPA with different
# administrative vintages of the same graduate. Revisions are diagnostic only.
meta<-jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(fu_input,'student_columns/metadata.json'),simplifyVector=FALSE)$value
projection<-jsonlite::fromJSON('analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/student_column_projection.json',simplifyVector=FALSE)
needed<-c('year','mrun','egreso_yyyy','promedio_notas','nem')
cols<-lapply(needed,function(nm){
 index<-as.integer(names(projection)[vapply(projection,identical,logical(1),nm)])+1L
 readBin(file.path(fu_input,'student_columns',paste0(nm,'.bin')),
 if(meta[[index]]$type==14L)'double' else 'integer',n=meta[[index]]$n,endian='big')
});names(cols)<-needed
reg<-as.data.table(cols);rm(cols)
reg<-reg[mrun>0 & egreso_yyyy %in% 2020:2024 & year>=egreso_yyyy+1L & year<=2025,
 .(MRUN=mrun,grad_year=as.integer(egreso_yyyy),process=as.integer(year),
 raw_gpa=promedio_notas,registered_nem=nem)]
reg<-merge(reg,fu[,.(MRUN,grad_year,nem_group,gpa_from_history,official_gpa_from_nem,nem_exact)],
 by=c('MRUN','grad_year'))
tab<-fread('analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/nem_tables_used.csv')
tab[,process:=grad_year+1L]
reg<-merge(reg,tab[,.(process,nem_group,registered_nem=score,vintage_gpa=gpa)],
 by=c('process','nem_group','registered_nem'),all.x=TRUE)
# Comparing implied GPAs rather than scores removes the 2023 scale change.
reg[,`:=`(matches_history=abs(vintage_gpa-gpa_from_history)<1e-8,
 matches_initial=abs(vintage_gpa-official_gpa_from_nem)<1e-8)]
fwrite(reg[,.(n=.N,valid=sum(!is.na(vintage_gpa)),
 history_agreement=mean(matches_history,na.rm=TRUE),
 initial_gpa_agreement=mean(matches_initial,na.rm=TRUE)),
 by=.(grad_year,process,nem_exact)],file.path(fu_out,'nem_registration_vintages.csv'))
late<-reg[process>grad_year+1L & !is.na(vintage_gpa),.(later_records=.N,
 any_later_matches_history=any(matches_history,na.rm=TRUE),
 any_later_changes_gpa=any(!matches_initial,na.rm=TRUE),
 all_later_match_initial=all(matches_initial %in% TRUE)),by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]
late<-merge(fu[is.finite(nem_error),.(MRUN,grad_year,nem_exact,nem_error)],late,
 by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
fwrite(late[,.(n=.N,with_later_record=sum(!is.na(later_records)),
 any_later_match_history=sum(any_later_matches_history %in% TRUE),
 any_later_gpa_revision=sum(any_later_changes_gpa %in% TRUE),
 all_later_match_initial=sum(all_later_match_initial %in% TRUE)),
 by=.(admission_year=grad_year+1L,nem_exact)],file.path(fu_out,'nem_later_registration_diagnostic.csv'))
# Explicit half-up versus truncation test on the same valid four-grade histories.
ft<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fu_input,'ranking_targets.rds')))
ft[,gpa_full:=rowMeans(.SD),.SDcols=paste0('gpa_',1:4)]
ft[,`:=`(round_proxy=nem_from_gpa(score_round(gpa_full,2L),grad_year+1L,nem_group,tab),
 trunc_proxy=nem_from_gpa(score_trunc(gpa_full,2L),grad_year+1L,nem_group,tab))]
fwrite(ft[complete_history==TRUE & reported_nem>0 & is.finite(round_proxy) & is.finite(trunc_proxy),
 .(n=.N,rounded_exact=mean(round_proxy==reported_nem),truncated_exact=mean(trunc_proxy==reported_nem),
 resolved_by_truncation=sum(round_proxy!=reported_nem & trunc_proxy==reported_nem),
 introduced_by_truncation=sum(round_proxy==reported_nem & trunc_proxy!=reported_nem)),
 by=.(admission_year=grad_year+1L)],file.path(fu_out,'nem_rounding_hypothesis.csv'))
print(fdi)
print(fu_validation[group=='All'])
```

diff<-fread(file.path(fu_out,'offer_differential_common_sample.csv'))

report<-c('# Follow-up: NEM and Ranking mismatches by year',

All new statistical work is in `code/analysis_for_adversarial_report.Rmd`, chunks `f08-score-followup-patterns`, `f08-score-followup-context-hypothesis`, `f08-score-followup-validation`, and `f08-score-followup-report`. ## Requested test: four annual Ranking scores instead of context blocks

The linked DEMRE page describes one Ranking calculation per high-school grade,
followed by an equal average. The existing reconstruction instead averages grades
inside consecutive school/modality contexts before scoring. These operations are
not interchangeable. The tests below preserve existing deliveries, examine both
TP-to-HC and HC-to-TP transitions, and use the admission-year score table/maximum.

```{r f08-ranking-annual-setup}
library(data.table)
setDTthreads(4)
ay_input<-'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/input/f08'
ay_out<-'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/annual_test_2026-10-19'
dir.create(ay_out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
ay_tables<-fread('analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/nem_tables_used.csv')
ay_t<-nem_from_history(as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(ay_input,'ranking_targets.rds'))),ay_tables)
ay_prev<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(ay_input,'ranking_context_hypothesis_2026-10-19.rds')))
ay_t<-merge(ay_t,ay_prev[,.(MRUN,grad_year,context_before=ranking_proxy_refined,
 context_latest=targeted_candidate)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
ay_t[,`:=`(has_th=FALSE,has_ht=FALSE)]
for(j in 1:3){
 ay_t[,has_th:=has_th | (get(paste0('teaching_',j))!=310L & get(paste0('teaching_',j+1L))==310L)]
 ay_t[,has_ht:=has_ht | (get(paste0('teaching_',j))==310L & get(paste0('teaching_',j+1L))!=310L)]
}
ay_t[,transition:=fcase(!complete_history,'Incomplete history',
 has_th & has_ht,'Both directions',has_th,'TP to HC',has_ht,'HC to TP',
 teaching_4==310L,'Stable HC',default='Stable TP')]
ay_t[,pattern:=paste(ifelse(teaching_1==310L,'H','T'),ifelse(teaching_2==310L,'H','T'),
 ifelse(teaching_3==310L,'H','T'),ifelse(teaching_4==310L,'H','T'),sep='')]
ay_long<-rbindlist(lapply(1:4,function(j){
 ay_t[complete_history==TRUE,.(MRUN,grad_year,grade=j,rbd=get(paste0('rbd_',j)),
 teaching=ifelse(get(paste0('teaching_',j))==310L,310L,410L),
 exit_year=get(paste0('year_',j)),g=get(paste0('gpa_',j)),
 nem_group,context_group=ifelse(get(paste0('teaching_',j))==310L,'A','C'))]
}),use.names=TRUE)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ay_long,by=c('MRUN','grad_year','grade')),
 all(ay_long[, .N,by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]$N==4L))
ay_ref<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(ay_input,'ranking_reference_modality_v2.rds')))[
 population=='exit_context' & first==last,
 .(rbd,teaching=ifelse(teaching==310L,310L,410L),exit_year,grade=first,n,
 sum_gpa=sum_full,max_gpa=max_full)]
# Input has exactly one passed-grade history per student/grade after upstream
# duplicate/conflict checks; reference includes nonregistrants.
ay_benchmarks<-function(population){
 r<-copy(ay_ref);q<-copy(ay_long)
 if(population=='school'){r[,teaching:=0L];q[,teaching:=0L]}
 r<-r[,.(n=sum(n),sum_gpa=sum(sum_gpa),max_gpa=max(max_gpa)),by=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,grade)]
 lagged<-rbindlist(lapply(1:3,function(lag){z<-copy(r);z[,`:=`(reference_year=exit_year,exit_year=exit_year+lag)];z}))
 keys<-unique(q[,.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,grade)])
 b<-lagged[keys,on=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,grade),nomatch=0,allow.cartesian=TRUE][,
 .(reference_n=sum(n),reference_cohorts=.N,latest_reference=max(reference_year),
 h_pooled=sum(sum_gpa)/sum(n),h_equal_rounded=mean(score_round(sum_gpa/n,2L)),
 m_pooled=max(max_gpa),m_mean=mean(max_gpa)),by=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,grade)]
 stopifnot(b[,all(latest_reference<exit_year)],!anyDuplicated(b,by=c('rbd','teaching','exit_year','grade')))
 ans<-merge(q,b,by=c('rbd','teaching','exit_year','grade'),all.x=TRUE)
 stopifnot(nrow(ans)==nrow(q),!anyDuplicated(ans,by=c('MRUN','grad_year','grade')))
 ans
}
ay_bench<-list(modality=ay_benchmarks('modality'),school=ay_benchmarks('school'))
fwrite(ay_t[,.(n=.N,observed=sum(is.finite(reported_ranking)),
 existing_candidate=sum(is.finite(context_latest))),by=.(admission_year=grad_year+1L,transition,one_school)],
 file.path(ay_out,'transition_sample_counts.csv'))
# The page embeds the interior equation as an image that could not be retrieved.
# Both candidate equations are sensitivities, not verified transcriptions.
ay_score<-function(g,h,m,cap,formula){
 interior<-switch(formula,linear_score=h+(cap-h)*(g-h)/(m-h),
 bonus_score=g+(cap-g)*(g-h)/(m-h),stop('Unknown formula'))
 ans<-ifelse(g<=h,g,ifelse(g>=m,cap,interior))
 ans[!is.finite(ans)|m<=h]<-NA_real_
 ans
}
# Boundary, missingness and formula tests, independent of recorded outcomes.
stopifnot(identical(ay_score(c(400,500,650,800),500,800,1000,'linear_score'),
 c(400,500,750,1000)),
 identical(ay_score(c(400,500,650,800),500,800,1000,'bonus_score'),c(400,500,825,1000)),
 is.na(ay_score(600,500,500,1000,'linear_score')))
```

```{r f08-ranking-annual-candidates}
# Primary comparisons isolate per-grade averaging, then use the webpage's
# pooled historical mean/maximum and converted-score interpolation. All
# specifications are uniform; no score is selected by its observed error.
ay_specs<-data.table(
 variant=c('annual_only_old_benchmarks','annual_pooled_modality_linear',
 'annual_pooled_school_linear','annual_pooled_modality_bonus','annual_pooled_school_bonus',
 'annual_meanmax_modality_linear','annual_pooled_modality_linear_round_each'),
 population=c('modality','modality','school','modality','school','modality','modality'),
 historical_mean=c('equal',rep('pooled',6)),maximum=c('mean',rep('pooled',4),'mean','pooled'),
 formula=c('linear_grade','linear_score','linear_score','bonus_score','bonus_score','linear_score','linear_score'),
 annual_round=c(TRUE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE,TRUE))
fwrite(ay_specs,file.path(ay_out,'candidate_specifications.csv'))
ay_results<-list();ay_outputs<-list();ay_coverage<-list()
for(k in seq_len(nrow(ay_specs))){
 spec<-ay_specs[k];cat('Annual candidate:',spec$variant,'\n')
 z<-copy(ay_bench[[spec$population]])
 h<-score_round(if(spec$historical_mean=='pooled')z$h_pooled else z$h_equal_rounded,2L)
 m<-score_round(if(spec$maximum=='pooled')z$m_pooled else z$m_mean,2L)
 g<-z$g;cap<-ifelse(z$grad_year<=2021L,850,1000)
 ng<-nem_from_gpa(g,z$grad_year+1L,z$context_group,ay_tables)
 nh<-nem_from_gpa(h,z$grad_year+1L,z$context_group,ay_tables)
 nm<-nem_from_gpa(m,z$grad_year+1L,z$context_group,ay_tables)
 if(spec$formula=='linear_grade'){
  annual<-ifelse(g<=h,ng,ifelse(g>=m,cap,nh+(cap-nh)*(g-h)/(m-h)))
  annual[!is.finite(annual)|m<=h]<-NA_real_
 } else annual<-ay_score(ng,nh,nm,cap,spec$formula)
 annual[is.na(z$reference_n)|z$reference_n<30L]<-NA_real_
 if(spec$annual_round)annual<-score_round(annual)
 z[,annual_score:=annual]
 a<-z[,.(n_grades=.N,valid_grades=sum(is.finite(annual_score)),
 annual_average=mean(annual_score),min_reference=min(reference_n),
 min_cohorts=min(reference_cohorts)),by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]
 stopifnot(all(a$n_grades==4L),a[valid_grades<4L,all(is.na(annual_average))])
 a[,annual_raw:=score_round(annual_average)]
 a<-merge(ay_t[,.(MRUN,grad_year,reported_ranking,nem_history_proxy,nem_recorded,
 pace12,transition,pattern,one_school,context_before,context_latest)],a,
 by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
 # The webpage's plain average is saved without imposing the old overall NEM
 # floor; flooring after aggregation is a separately labeled sensitivity.
 a[,annual_floored:=pmax(annual_raw,nem_history_proxy)]
 a[,variant:=spec$variant]
 ay_outputs[[k]]<-a[,.(MRUN,grad_year,variant,annual_raw,annual_floored,valid_grades)]
 ay_coverage[[k]]<-a[,.(n=.N,recorded=sum(is.finite(reported_ranking)),
 previous_available=sum(is.finite(context_latest)),annual_available=sum(is.finite(annual_raw)),
 gained=sum(is.finite(annual_raw)&!is.finite(context_latest)),
 lost=sum(!is.finite(annual_raw)&is.finite(context_latest))),
 by=.(variant,admission_year=grad_year+1L,transition)]
 for(floor_rule in c('raw','floored')){
  value<-paste0('annual_',floor_rule)
  q<-a[is.finite(get(value))&is.finite(context_latest)&is.finite(reported_ranking)]
  q[,`:=`(new_error=get(value)-reported_ranking,old_error=context_latest-reported_ranking)]
  metrics<-rbindlist(list(
   q[,c(list(method='Previous context candidate'),score_metrics(old_error)),
    by=.(variant,admission_year=grad_year+1L,transition,pace12,one_school)],
   q[,c(list(method='Four annual scores'),score_metrics(new_error)),
    by=.(variant,admission_year=grad_year+1L,transition,pace12,one_school)]),use.names=TRUE)
  metrics[,floor_rule:=floor_rule]
  ay_results[[paste(k,floor_rule)]]<-metrics
 }
}
ay_results<-rbindlist(ay_results,use.names=TRUE)
ay_outputs<-rbindlist(ay_outputs,use.names=TRUE)
fwrite(ay_results,file.path(ay_out,'annual_same_sample_validation.csv'))
fwrite(rbindlist(ay_coverage,use.names=TRUE),file.path(ay_out,'annual_coverage.csv'))
saveRDS(ay_outputs,file.path(ay_input,'ranking_annual_candidates_2026-10-19.rds'))
ay_summary<-ay_results[n>0,.(n=sum(n),exact=weighted.mean(exact,n),
 within_1=weighted.mean(within_1,n),within_5=weighted.mean(within_5,n),
 mae=weighted.mean(mae,n),bias=weighted.mean(bias,n)),by=.(variant,floor_rule,method,transition)]
fwrite(ay_summary,file.path(ay_out,'annual_transition_summary.csv'))
print(ay_summary[transition=='TP to HC'])
# Ensure the prior candidate files have not been altered.
ay_inputs<-c('ranking_targets.rds','ranking_reference_modality_v2.rds',
 'ranking_context_hypothesis_2026-10-19.rds','score_reconstruction_records.rds')
fwrite(data.table(input=ay_inputs,md5=unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(ay_input,ay_inputs)))),
 file.path(ay_out,'input_provenance.csv'))
```

```{r f08-ranking-annual-report}
 ys$admission_year[i],fmt(ys$n[i]),100*ys[['exact_Previous context candidate']][i],

 ys[['mae_Four annual scores']][i]),character(1))
sens<-s[transition=='TP to HC' & floor_rule=='floored' & method=='Four annual scores']
srows<-vapply(seq_len(nrow(sens)),function(i)sprintf('| `%s` | %s | %.2f%% | %.3f |',
 sens$variant[i],fmt(sens$n[i]),100*sens$exact[i],sens$mae[i]),character(1))

Implementing annual scores does not reduce observed discrepancies. The equation between the boundary cases is embedded in an image that could not be retrieved for inspection. The converted-score equations below are therefore alternative implementations, not a certified transcription of that image.',

 '- Preserve the independently reconstructed overall NEM floor in the main comparison; also save the literal annual average without that floor. Neither uses recorded Ranking to construct predictions.',
 '- All before/after comparisons use the identical observed-score students for that candidate. These are raw-code transitions and may include administrative recoding.',
 '- Missing annual inputs or fewer than 30 historical records leave the score unknown. Official small-school pooling, foreign-school and free-exam substitutions remain unimplemented. Coverage differences are reported separately; the test does not extrapolate accuracy to students without observed scores.',
 '', '## Admission-year results: isolate annual averaging',
 '', '| Admission year | Same students | Context exact | Annual exact | Context MAE | Annual MAE |',

 '', 'Exact agreement deteriorates and absolute error increases in every admission year. Point errors are in each year’s native scale; the within-year results avoid conflating the scale change with performance.',

 '', '| Annual candidate (with NEM floor) | Same-sample N | Exact | MAE |',
 '|---|---:|---:|---:|',srows,
 '', 'Candidate definitions are in `candidate_specifications.csv`. `linear_score` interpolates from converted historical mean h to the cap c: h+(c-h)(g-h)/(m-h); `bonus_score` uses g+(c-g)(g-h)/(m-h). Both have the same lower/upper boundary rules. Neither is represented as the verified image formula. All seven candidates worsen replication for TP-to-HC students. This checks the temporal aggregation implementation independently of recorded scores.',fmt(check$n)),
```

## Short historical records: official rules and pooling diagnostics

The October 19 search of DEMRE and MINEDUC confirms that one or two available
historical cohorts suffice when the relevant school has more than 30 graduates;
small schools instead require grouping by region, educational modality and
administrative dependency. The public sources specify these criteria but do not
provide the operational school-group assignments. Pooling below is therefore a
sensitivity, not a replacement official score. Preserve the accepted narrow HHTT
context candidate and all recorded scores throughout.

```{r f08-ranking-short-history-setup}
library(data.table)
setDTthreads(4)
sh_input<-'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/input/f08'
sh_out<-'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/short_history_2026-10-19'
dir.create(sh_out,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
sh_files<-c('ranking_targets.rds','ranking_reference_historical_gpa_v5.rds',
 'ranking_context_hypothesis_2026-10-19.rds','score_reconstruction_records.rds')
fwrite(data.table(input=sh_files,md5=unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(sh_input,sh_files)))),
 file.path(sh_out,'input_provenance.csv'))
sh_tables<-fread('analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/nem_tables_used.csv')
sh_t<-nem_from_history(as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(sh_input,'ranking_targets.rds'))),sh_tables)
sh_prev<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(sh_input,'ranking_context_hypothesis_2026-10-19.rds')))
sh_t<-merge(sh_t,sh_prev[,.(MRUN,grad_year,baseline=targeted_candidate,target_transition)],
 by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
for(j in 1:4)set(sh_t,j=paste0('teaching_',j),value=ifelse(sh_t[[paste0('teaching_',j)]]==310,310L,410L))
sh_r<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(sh_input,'ranking_reference_historical_gpa_v5.rds')))
sh_r[,teaching:=ifelse(teaching==310,310L,410L)]
sh_r<-sh_r[population=='exit_context',.(n=sum(n),sum_trunc=sum(sum_trunc),sum_round=sum(sum_round),
 sum_full=sum(sum_full),max_trunc=max(max_trunc),max_round=max(max_round),max_full=max(max_full)),
 by=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,first,last,population)]
sh_c<-rbindlist(list(ranking_student_contexts(sh_t[target_transition!=TRUE|is.na(target_transition)]),
 ranking_student_contexts(sh_t[target_transition==TRUE],split_teaching=FALSE)),use.names=TRUE)
sh_c<-ranking_context_benchmarks(sh_c,sh_r)
sh_c[,h_round_raw:=h_equal_rounded_cohort_raw]
sh_check<-ranking_from_contexts(sh_c,sh_tables,own='round',historical='round',
 benchmark_precision='round',context_rounding='round')
sh_check<-merge(sh_t[,.(MRUN,grad_year,baseline,nem_history_proxy)],sh_check,
 by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
sh_check[,check:=pmax(ranking_calculated,nem_history_proxy)]
stopifnot(sh_check[,all(is.na(baseline)==is.na(check))],
 sh_check[is.finite(baseline),all(check==baseline)])
# Count observed fourth-grade graduates independently of the length of the
# student's context. These remain extract counts, not an official DEMRE roster.
sh_gr<-sh_r[first==4L&last==4L,.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,n)]
sh_lags<-rbindlist(lapply(1:3,function(lag){z<-copy(sh_gr);z[,exit_year:=exit_year+lag];z}))
sh_mod<-sh_lags[,.(modality_graduates=sum(n),modality_cohorts=.N),by=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year)]
sh_all<-sh_lags[,.(school_graduates=sum(n)),by=.(rbd,exit_year)]
sh_c<-merge(sh_c,sh_mod,by=c('rbd','teaching','exit_year'),all.x=TRUE)
sh_c<-merge(sh_c,sh_all[,.(rbd,exit_year,school_graduates)],by=c('rbd','exit_year'),all.x=TRUE)
# Directory classifications are taken at the student's context-exit year.
# Original regional codes avoid retrospectively moving historical schools to Nuble.
sh_directory_path<-'/Users/iriosu/Dropbox/Effect SAE on SUA/data/panel_ee_2004_2025_homogenized.rds'
sh_d<-as.data.table(readRDS(sh_directory_path))[,.(rbd,exit_year=year,
 region=cod_reg_rbd_original,dependency=cod_depe)]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sh_d,by=c('rbd','exit_year')))
sh_c<-merge(sh_c,sh_d,by=c('rbd','exit_year'),all.x=TRUE)
sh_c[,context_id:=.I]
sh_c[,history_status:=fcase(is.na(reference_n),'No usable context reference',
 reference_n<30L,'Fewer than 30 context records',reference_n==30L,'Exactly 30 context records',
 reference_generations<3L,'One/two cohorts, over 30 records',default='Three cohorts, over 30 records')]
sh_student_status<-sh_c[,.(any_no_reference=any(is.na(reference_n)),
 any_small=any(reference_n<30L,na.rm=TRUE),any_exact30=any(reference_n==30L,na.rm=TRUE),
 any_short=any(reference_generations<3L,na.rm=TRUE),
 any_small_modality=any(is.na(modality_graduates)|modality_graduates<30L),
 any_small_school=any(is.na(school_graduates)|school_graduates<30L)),by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]
sh_t<-merge(sh_t,sh_student_status,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
sh_t[,history_status:=fcase(!complete_history,'Incomplete own history',
 any_no_reference,'No usable context reference',any_small,'Fewer than 30 context records',
 any_exact30,'Exactly 30 context records',any_short,'One/two cohorts, over 30 records',
 default='Three cohorts, over 30 records')]
fwrite(sh_c[,.(contexts=.N,students=uniqueN(paste(MRUN,grad_year)),
 missing_directory=sum(is.na(region)|is.na(dependency)),
 small_modality=sum(is.na(modality_graduates)|modality_graduates<30L),
 small_school=sum(is.na(school_graduates)|school_graduates<30L)),
 by=.(admission_year=grad_year+1L,history_status)],file.path(sh_out,'context_reference_audit.csv'))
fwrite(sh_t[,.(graduates=.N,recorded=sum(is.finite(reported_ranking)),
 available=sum(is.finite(baseline)),validated=sum(is.finite(baseline)&is.finite(reported_ranking)),
 mismatches=sum(is.finite(baseline)&is.finite(reported_ranking)&baseline!=reported_ranking),
 absolute_error=sum(abs(baseline-reported_ranking),na.rm=TRUE)),
 by=.(admission_year=grad_year+1L,pace12,history_status)],file.path(sh_out,'baseline_history_audit.csv'))
saveRDS(sh_c,file.path(sh_input,'ranking_short_history_contexts_2026-10-19.rds'))
```

```{r f08-ranking-short-history-candidates}
# Pooling definitions are fixed before examining scores. No student gets a
# bespoke rule selected by agreement with the observed outcome.
sh_specs<-CJ(gate=c('modality','school'),pool=c('none','small_only','all_similar'))
sh_specs[,variant:=paste(gate,pool,sep='_')]
fwrite(sh_specs,file.path(sh_out,'specifications.csv'))
sh_scores<-list();sh_pool_audit<-list()
sh_calc<-function(z){
 # Reference count used for eligibility is a separate quantity; never replace
 # the actual number underlying a mean/max in the saved context diagnostics.
 g<-z$g_round;h<-score_round(z$h_round_raw,2L);m<-score_round(z$m_round_raw,2L)
 ng<-nem_from_gpa(g,z$grad_year+1L,z$context_group,sh_tables)
 nh<-nem_from_gpa(h,z$grad_year+1L,z$context_group,sh_tables)
 cap<-ifelse(z$grad_year<=2021,850,1000)
 s<-ifelse(g<=h,ng,ifelse(g>=m,cap,nh+(cap-nh)*(g-h)/(m-h)))
 s[!is.finite(s)|m<=h|is.na(z$eligibility_n)|z$eligibility_n<30L]<-NA_real_
 z[,score:=score_round(s)]
 ans<-z[,.(candidate=score_round(sum(score*length)/4)),by=.(MRUN,grad_year)]
 ans<-merge(sh_t,ans,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
 ans[,candidate:=pmax(candidate,nem_history_proxy)]
 ans
}
# Independence check: the local scorer matches the established function exactly.
z<-copy(sh_c);z[,eligibility_n:=reference_n]
a<-sh_calc(z);stopifnot(a[,all(is.na(candidate)==is.na(baseline))],
 a[is.finite(baseline),all(candidate==baseline)])
# Expand annual context summaries into their eligible three-year windows.
sh_lr<-rbindlist(lapply(1:3,function(lag){z<-copy(sh_r);
 z[,`:=`(reference_year=exit_year,exit_year=exit_year+lag)];z}))
sh_lr<-merge(sh_lr,sh_d,by=c('rbd','exit_year'),all.x=TRUE)
sh_lr<-merge(sh_lr,sh_mod,by=c('rbd','teaching','exit_year'),all.x=TRUE)
sh_lr<-merge(sh_lr,sh_all[,.(rbd,exit_year,school_graduates)],by=c('rbd','exit_year'),all.x=TRUE)
stopifnot(sh_lr[,all(reference_year<exit_year & exit_year-reference_year<=3L)])
for(k in seq_len(nrow(sh_specs))){
 spec<-sh_specs[k];cat('Short-history candidate:',spec$variant,'\n')
 z<-copy(sh_c);gate_col<-paste0(spec$gate,'_graduates')
 z[,eligibility_n:=get(gate_col)]
 # A missing graduation-count cell is treated as insufficient *observed*
 # history, not proof that the school had no actual graduates.
 need<-is.na(z$eligibility_n)|z$eligibility_n<30L
 if(spec$pool!='none'){
  d<-sh_lr[!is.na(region)&!is.na(dependency)]
  if(spec$pool=='small_only')d<-d[is.na(get(gate_col))|get(gate_col)<30L]
  # Treat pooled schools as one school within each historical year, then
  # apply the retained equal-cohort-mean / mean-of-maxima convention.
  p<-d[,.(n=sum(n),sum_round=sum(sum_round),max_round=max(max_round),schools=uniqueN(rbd)),
   by=.(region,dependency,teaching,exit_year,first,last,reference_year)]
  p<-p[,.(pool_n=sum(n),pool_cohorts=.N,
   pool_h=mean(score_round(sum_round/n,2L)),pool_m=mean(max_round),
   min_schools=min(schools)),by=.(region,dependency,teaching,exit_year,first,last)]
  z<-merge(z,p,by=c('region','dependency','teaching','exit_year','first','last'),all.x=TRUE)
  setorder(z,context_id);need<-is.na(z$eligibility_n)|z$eligibility_n<30L
  z[need,`:=`(h_round_raw=pool_h,m_round_raw=pool_m,eligibility_n=pool_n)]
  z[,variant:=spec$variant]
  sh_pool_audit[[k]]<-z[need,.(contexts=.N,with_pool=sum(is.finite(pool_h)&pool_n>=30L,na.rm=TRUE),
   one_school_pool=sum(min_schools==1L,na.rm=TRUE),unknown_metadata=sum(is.na(region)|is.na(dependency))),
   by=.(variant,admission_year=grad_year+1L)]
 }
 a<-sh_calc(z);a[,variant:=spec$variant]
 stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(a,by=c('MRUN','grad_year')),
  a[is.finite(candidate),all(candidate>=nem_history_proxy & candidate<=ifelse(grad_year<=2021,850,1000))])
 sh_scores[[k]]<-a[,.(MRUN,grad_year,variant,candidate)]
}
sh_scores<-rbindlist(sh_scores,use.names=TRUE)
saveRDS(sh_scores,file.path(sh_input,'ranking_short_history_candidates_2026-10-19.rds'))
fwrite(rbindlist(sh_pool_audit,use.names=TRUE),file.path(sh_out,'pooling_coverage.csv'))
sh_v<-merge(sh_scores,sh_t[,.(MRUN,grad_year,reported_ranking,baseline,nem_history_proxy,
 nem_recorded,pace12,history_status,any_small_modality,any_small_school)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
sh_v[,`:=`(error=candidate-reported_ranking,baseline_error=baseline-reported_ranking)]
sh_metrics<-list()
for(scope in c('common','newly_available','lost','all_available')){
 q<-switch(scope,common=sh_v[is.finite(candidate)&is.finite(baseline)],
 newly_available=sh_v[is.finite(candidate)&!is.finite(baseline)],
 lost=sh_v[!is.finite(candidate)&is.finite(baseline)],all_available=sh_v[is.finite(candidate)])
 sh_metrics[[scope]]<-q[,c(list(scope=scope,graduates=.N),score_metrics(error),
 list(baseline_n=sum(is.finite(baseline_error)),
 baseline_exact=mean(baseline_error==0,na.rm=TRUE),baseline_mae=mean(abs(baseline_error),na.rm=TRUE),
 resolved=sum(error==0&baseline_error!=0,na.rm=TRUE),introduced=sum(error!=0&baseline_error==0,na.rm=TRUE))),
 by=.(variant,admission_year=grad_year+1L,pace12,history_status)]
}
sh_metrics<-rbindlist(sh_metrics,use.names=TRUE)
fwrite(sh_metrics,file.path(sh_out,'candidate_validation.csv'))
sh_summary<-sh_metrics[n>0,.(n=sum(n),exact=weighted.mean(exact,n),mae=weighted.mean(mae,n),
 baseline_exact=if(all(is.finite(baseline_exact)))weighted.mean(baseline_exact,baseline_n) else NA_real_,
 baseline_mae=if(all(is.finite(baseline_mae)))weighted.mean(baseline_mae,baseline_n) else NA_real_,
 resolved=sum(resolved),introduced=sum(introduced)),by=.(variant,scope)]
fwrite(sh_summary,file.path(sh_out,'candidate_summary.csv'));print(sh_summary)
fwrite(sh_v[,.(graduates=.N,baseline=sum(is.finite(baseline)),candidate=sum(is.finite(candidate)),
 gained=sum(is.finite(candidate)&!is.finite(baseline)),lost=sum(!is.finite(candidate)&is.finite(baseline)),
 changed=sum(is.finite(candidate)&is.finite(baseline)&candidate!=baseline)),
 by=.(variant,admission_year=grad_year+1L,pace12)],file.path(sh_out,'candidate_coverage.csv'))
sh_hash<-fread(file.path(sh_out,'input_provenance.csv'))
stopifnot(identical(unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(sh_input,sh_hash$input))),sh_hash$md5))
```

```{r f08-ranking-first-pass-history}

 COD_ENSE %in% c(310L,410L,510L,610L,710L,810L,910L)&COD_GRADO %in% 1:4]),use.names=TRUE)

fp_new<-merge(fp_meta,fp_w,by='MRUN',all.x=TRUE)
fp_new[,complete_history:=!is.na(gpa_1+gpa_2+gpa_3+gpa_4)&

fp_new[is.na(complete_history),complete_history:=FALSE]
fp_new[,`:=`(gpa_round=score_round((gpa_1+gpa_2+gpa_3+gpa_4)/4,2L),

stopifnot(qa[is.finite(old_nem),all(new_nem==old_nem)])

hg[admission_year<2016L,official_gpa:=NA_real_]

 sum_full=sum(historical_gpa),max_trunc=max(historical_gpa),max_round=max(historical_gpa),

saveRDS(fp_ref,file.path(fp_input,'ranking_first_pass_reference_2026-10-19.rds'))
saveRDS(fp_new,file.path(fp_input,'ranking_first_pass_targets_2026-10-19.rds'))
rm(fp_w,w,r,hg);gc()
```

```{r f08-ranking-first-pass-validation}
library(data.table)
setDTthreads(4)
fp_input<-'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/input/f08'
fp_out<-'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/short_history_2026-10-19'
fp_tables<-fread('analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/nem_tables_used.csv')
fp_old<-nem_from_history(as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fp_input,'ranking_targets.rds'))),fp_tables)
fp_new<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fp_input,'ranking_first_pass_targets_2026-10-19.rds')))
fp_base<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fp_input,'ranking_context_hypothesis_2026-10-19.rds')))
fp_old<-merge(fp_old,fp_base[,.(MRUN,grad_year,baseline=targeted_candidate)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
fp_specs<-data.table(variant=c('first_pass_own_only','first_pass_reference_only','first_pass_both'),
 own=c(TRUE,FALSE,TRUE),reference=c(FALSE,TRUE,TRUE))
fp_results<-list()
for(k in seq_len(nrow(fp_specs))){
 spec<-fp_specs[k];cat('First-pass candidate:',spec$variant,'\n')
 t<-copy(if(spec$own)fp_new else fp_old)
 r<-as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(fp_input,if(spec$reference)
 'ranking_first_pass_reference_2026-10-19.rds' else 'ranking_reference_historical_gpa_v5.rds')))
 for(j in 1:4)set(t,j=paste0('teaching_',j),value=ifelse(t[[paste0('teaching_',j)]]==310,310L,410L))
 t[,target_transition:=one_school==TRUE & teaching_1==310L & teaching_2==310L &
 teaching_3==410L & teaching_4==410L]
 r[,teaching:=ifelse(teaching==310L,310L,410L)]
 r<-r[population=='exit_context',.(n=sum(n),sum_trunc=sum(sum_trunc),sum_round=sum(sum_round),
 sum_full=sum(sum_full),max_trunc=max(max_trunc),max_round=max(max_round),max_full=max(max_full)),
 by=.(rbd,teaching,exit_year,first,last,population)]
 c<-rbindlist(list(ranking_student_contexts(t[target_transition!=TRUE|is.na(target_transition)]),
 ranking_student_contexts(t[target_transition==TRUE],split_teaching=FALSE)),use.names=TRUE)
 c<-ranking_context_benchmarks(c,r);c[,h_round_raw:=h_equal_rounded_cohort_raw]
 a<-ranking_from_contexts(c,fp_tables,own='round',historical='round',
 benchmark_precision='round',context_rounding='round')
 a<-merge(t,a,by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
 a[,candidate:=pmax(ranking_calculated,nem_history_proxy)]
 a[,variant:=spec$variant]
 fp_results[[k]]<-a[,.(MRUN,grad_year,variant,candidate,nem_history_proxy)]
}
fp_results<-rbindlist(fp_results,use.names=TRUE)
saveRDS(fp_results,file.path(fp_input,'ranking_first_pass_candidates_2026-10-19.rds'))
v<-merge(fp_results,fp_old[,.(MRUN,grad_year,baseline,reported_ranking,nem_recorded,
 old_nem=nem_history_proxy,pace12)],by=c('MRUN','grad_year'),all.x=TRUE)
v[,`:=`(error=candidate-reported_ranking,baseline_error=baseline-reported_ranking,
 nem_error=nem_history_proxy-nem_recorded)]
v[,scope:=fcase(is.finite(candidate)&is.finite(baseline),'common',
 is.finite(candidate)&!is.finite(baseline),'newly_available',
 !is.finite(candidate)&is.finite(baseline),'lost',default='unavailable')]
m<-v[,c(list(graduates=.N),score_metrics(error),list(
 baseline_n=sum(is.finite(baseline_error)),baseline_exact=mean(baseline_error==0,na.rm=TRUE),
 baseline_mae=mean(abs(baseline_error),na.rm=TRUE),resolved=sum(error==0&baseline_error!=0,na.rm=TRUE),
 introduced=sum(error!=0&baseline_error==0,na.rm=TRUE))),
 by=.(variant,scope,admission_year=grad_year+1L,pace12)]
fwrite(m,file.path(fp_out,'first_pass_validation.csv'))
fwrite(m[n>0,.(n=sum(n),exact=weighted.mean(exact,n),mae=weighted.mean(mae,n),
 baseline_exact=if(all(is.finite(baseline_exact)))weighted.mean(baseline_exact,baseline_n) else NA_real_,
 baseline_mae=if(all(is.finite(baseline_mae)))weighted.mean(baseline_mae,baseline_n) else NA_real_,
 resolved=sum(resolved),introduced=sum(introduced)),by=.(variant,scope)],
 file.path(fp_out,'first_pass_summary.csv'))
fwrite(v[variant=='first_pass_both',c(list(graduates=.N),score_metrics(nem_error)),
 by=.(admission_year=grad_year+1L,nem_previously_available=is.finite(old_nem),pace12)],
 file.path(fp_out,'first_pass_nem_validation.csv'))
fwrite(v[,.(graduates=.N,available=sum(is.finite(candidate)),
 missing_recorded_filled=sum(is.finite(candidate)&!is.finite(reported_ranking)),
 changed=sum(is.finite(candidate)&is.finite(baseline)&candidate!=baseline)),
 by=.(variant,scope,admission_year=grad_year+1L,pace12)],file.path(fp_out,'first_pass_coverage.csv'))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(v,by=c('MRUN','grad_year','variant')),
 v[is.finite(candidate),all(candidate>=nem_history_proxy&candidate<=ifelse(grad_year<=2021,850,1000))],
 v[variant=='first_pass_own_only'&is.finite(baseline),all(candidate==baseline)])
print(fread(file.path(fp_out,'first_pass_summary.csv')))
```

```{r f08-ranking-short-history-report}
library(data.table)
sh_input<-'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/input/f08'
sh_out<-'analysis_for_adversarial_report_output/f08/ranking/short_history_2026-10-19'
b<-fread(file.path(sh_out,'baseline_history_audit.csv'))
b<-b[,.(graduates=sum(graduates),validated=sum(validated),mismatches=sum(mismatches),
 absolute_error=sum(absolute_error)),by=history_status]
s<-fread(file.path(sh_out,'candidate_summary.csv'))
f<-fread(file.path(sh_out,'first_pass_summary.csv'))
nem<-fread(file.path(sh_out,'first_pass_nem_validation.csv'))
fc<-fread(file.path(sh_out,'first_pass_coverage.csv'))
cv<-fread(file.path(sh_out,'candidate_coverage.csv'))
fmt<-function(x)format(x,big.mark=',',scientific=FALSE,trim=TRUE)
tab<-function(x)vapply(seq_len(nrow(x)),function(i)sprintf('| %s | %s | %.2f%% | %.3f | %s | %s |',
 x$variant[i],fmt(x$n[i]),100*x$exact[i],x$mae[i],fmt(x$resolved[i]),fmt(x$introduced[i])),character(1))
short<-b[history_status=='One/two cohorts, over 30 records']
report<-c('# Short historical records and first-passed-grade audit — October 19, 2026',
 '', '## Official-source findings',
 '', 'The [source review](../../sources/ranking/short_history_2026-10-19/source_review.md) records the DEMRE/MINEDUC URLs, relevant provisions, historical applicability, and unresolved operational choices.',
 '', '- For the study years, fewer than 30 school graduates across the previous three generations triggers pooling with schools similar in region, modality and dependency. One or two cohorts with more than 30 graduates suffice without pooling. Our current code already averages the available historical cohorts; it does not require all three.',
 '- The public provisions reviewed do not supply exact pre-2028 pool assignments. They also do not explicitly settle equality at 30. The diagnostics retain the existing >=30 convention, audit equality separately and distinguish school-wide graduates from context-reference records.',
 '- The MINEDUC September 2025 committee annex provides a more detailed 93-student/commune-to-province-to-region pooling rule **from admission 2028**. It is not applicable to the 2021–2026 sample. The same annex describes context-based scoring through 2027.',
 '- A separate MINEDUC rule, also documented in its 2018 manual, says to use the first passed instance when a grade was passed in different years. Our earlier cache discarded all such multiple records. This was tested separately as a potential loss of students and historical peers. Earliest-year conflicts remain unknown because we lack within-year enrollment dates.',
 '', '## Size of the short-history problem',
 '', sprintf('Among %s validated students with one/two usable context cohorts and more than 30 records, the accepted context candidate matches %.2f%% exactly. They account for %s remaining mismatches (%.2f%% of all mismatches), but %.2f%% of remaining absolute error. Most remaining mismatches therefore occur with all three observed cohorts.',
 fmt(short$validated),100*(1-short$mismatches/short$validated),fmt(short$mismatches),
 100*short$mismatches/sum(b$mismatches),100*short$absolute_error/sum(b$absolute_error)),
 '', sprintf('Among complete own histories, %s students have at least one context with fewer than 30 usable records and %s have no usable reference for at least one context. These categories concern the observed extract; they do not establish true absence in DEMRE’s administrative records. A further %s have incomplete own histories.',
 fmt(b[history_status=='Fewer than 30 context records',graduates]),
 fmt(b[history_status=='No usable context reference',graduates]),fmt(b[history_status=='Incomplete own history',graduates])),
 '', '## Pooling and threshold experiments',
 '', 'All specifications preserve the accepted narrow same-school HHTT convention, the existing score formula and rounding, and the independent NEM floor. The two threshold units are whole-school graduates and school-modality graduates, observed from passed fourth-grade records. Directory region and exact dependency codes refer to the student’s context-exit year. Within each matching group, tests either pool only small schools or all comparable schools. Each historical year is aggregated first, then the existing mean-of-cohort-means and mean-of-cohort-maxima convention is applied. These are declared approximations, not verified official pools.',
 '', '| Candidate, common observed-score sample | N | Exact | MAE | Resolved | Introduced |',
 '|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|',tab(s[scope=='common']),
 '', 'The `none` variants do not improve any existing prediction: their apparent aggregate gains reflect dropping difficult observations. All pooling variants introduce more errors than they resolve. Newly available cases must be assessed separately:',
 '', '| Candidate, newly available observed-score sample | N | Exact | MAE | Resolved | Introduced |',
 '|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|',tab(s[scope=='newly_available']),
 '', 'No pooling or threshold variant is adopted. Coverage tables include lost cases and graduates without observed scores; comparison metrics never treat missing predictions as matches.',
 '', '## First-passed-grade experiment',
 '', 'The implementation selects the earliest year with a unique passed record for each student/grade. A unique later record is not substituted for conflicts in the first year. Only regular youth-secondary teaching codes are included. Complete target histories must be chronological and end in the target graduation year. Reference cohorts always precede the relevant context-exit year; the available raw grade window remains 2010–2025. Historical graduation-GPA reconciliation is retained, and the new grades never use current observed Ranking to choose a record.',
 '', 'Three fixed variants separate recovery of the student’s own history from recovery of historical peers. Previously complete own histories and their independent NEM remain unchanged.',
 '', '| First-pass candidate, common observed-score sample | N | Exact | MAE | Resolved | Introduced |',
 '|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|',tab(f[scope=='common']),
 '', '| First-pass candidate, newly available observed-score sample | N | Exact | MAE | Resolved | Introduced |',
 '|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|',tab(f[scope=='newly_available']),
 '', sprintf('Independent NEM for newly reconstructible observed-score histories matches %.2f%% exactly over %s cases; MAE is %.3f points. These are recovered-history cases, not a same-sample gain in accuracy over previously complete histories.',
 100*nem[nem_previously_available==FALSE & n>0,weighted.mean(exact,n)],
 fmt(nem[nem_previously_available==FALSE,sum(n)]),nem[nem_previously_available==FALSE & n>0,weighted.mean(mae,n)]),
 '', sprintf('**Decision:** the reference-only first-pass variant is a small promising refinement: exact agreement changes from %.4f%% to %.4f%% on the same %s cases, resolving %s errors and introducing %s (net %s). Keep it as a separate provisional candidate. The own-history recovery is not adopted: low validation accuracy suggests that repeated passed entries in these extracts can represent unresolved record revisions or other cases beyond genuine repeat completions; that explanation is a hypothesis, not established by the test.',
 100*f[variant=='first_pass_reference_only'&scope=='common',baseline_exact],
 100*f[variant=='first_pass_reference_only'&scope=='common',exact],
 fmt(f[variant=='first_pass_reference_only'&scope=='common',n]),
 fmt(f[variant=='first_pass_reference_only'&scope=='common',resolved]),
 fmt(f[variant=='first_pass_reference_only'&scope=='common',introduced]),
 fmt(f[variant=='first_pass_reference_only'&scope=='common',resolved-introduced])),
 '', 'The private candidates and original deliveries remain separate. The full-year/PACE breakdown, gained/lost counts and error metrics are in the accompanying CSVs. Exact agreement for the reference-only first-pass variant improves in every admission year, but these are exploratory in-sample checks, not a held-out validation. This refinement does not recover the official school pools or establish full PACE qualification.',
 '', '## Checks, files and reproduction',
 '', '- Baseline reconstruction reproduces the accepted narrow HHTT candidate exactly, including its missingness. The local diagnostic scorer separately reproduces that baseline. Checks also cover earliest-year uniqueness, unchanged NEM on previously complete histories, score bounds, unique graduate/variant keys and preservation of prior score-delivery hashes.',
 '- Statistical code is exclusively in `code/analysis_for_adversarial_report.Rmd`. From `code/`, run `f08-score-reconstruction-functions`, `f08-ranking-short-history-setup`, `f08-ranking-short-history-candidates`, `f08-ranking-first-pass-history`, `f08-ranking-first-pass-validation`, then `f08-ranking-short-history-report`. The first-pass history chunk rebuilds its versioned caches; the validation and report chunks may be run against saved outputs.',
 '- Besides the private inputs named in the chunks, pooling uses the local `panel_ee_2004_2025_homogenized.rds` school directory. Edit `sh_directory_path` on another machine. Its current hash is recorded below. No student-level records are committed to Git.',
 '- New private files are `ranking_short_history_contexts_2026-10-19.rds`, `ranking_short_history_candidates_2026-10-19.rds`, `ranking_first_pass_histories_2026-10-19.rds`, `ranking_first_pass_targets_2026-10-19.rds`, `ranking_first_pass_reference_2026-10-19.rds`, and `ranking_first_pass_candidates_2026-10-19.rds` under `input/f08/`.',
 '- F08.3 remains open: official reference populations/pools, exact arithmetic, adult/foreign/free-exam histories, full PACE percentile/tie/carryover rules and resulting mechanism estimates are unresolved. No manuscript estimates are changed.')
writeLines(report,file.path(sh_out,'short_history_report_2026-10-19.md'))
p<-fread(file.path(sh_out,'input_provenance.csv'))
stopifnot(identical(unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(sh_input,p$input))),p$md5))
extra<-c('ranking_grade_records_2010_2023.rds','rendimiento_grades_2024_2025.rds','historical_official_gpa.rds')
fwrite(data.table(input=extra,md5=unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(sh_input,extra)))),
 file.path(sh_out,'first_pass_input_provenance.csv'))
fwrite(data.table(input='panel_ee_2004_2025_homogenized.rds',
 md5=unname(tools::md5sum('/Users/iriosu/Dropbox/Effect SAE on SUA/data/panel_ee_2004_2025_homogenized.rds'))),
 file.path(sh_out,'school_directory_provenance.csv'))
fwrite(data.table(package=c('R','data.table'),version=c(as.character(getRversion()),
 as.character(packageVersion('data.table')))),file.path(sh_out,'runtime_versions.csv'))
cat('Short-history report written; original scores unchanged.\n')
```
